programme.title: Class reunion 1.0: The incredible journey of the silver jerking / Klassentreffen 1.0: Die unglaubliche Reise der Silberrucken
programme.desc: Nils, Andreas and Thomas graduated from high school 30 years ago and are all invited to their class reunion. While Nils and Andreas actually have completely different worries, Thomas is looking forward to the meeting. But he also got into trouble when the wife of his heart asks him to take care of her daughter. Suddenly he can refuse Nils and Andreas who have to deal with children and wives. / Nils, Andreas und Thomas haben vor 30 Jahren gemeinsam Abitur gemacht und sind alle zu ihrem Klassentreffen eingeladen. Wahrend Nils und Andreas eigentlich ganz andere Sorgen haben, freut sich Thomas richtig auf die Zusammenkunft. Doch auch er gerat in Schwierigkeiten, als die Frau seines Herzens ihn bittet, auf ihre Tochter aufzupassen. Plotzlich kann er Nils und Andreas nachfuhlen, die sich mit Kindern und Ehefrauen herumschlagen mussen.

programme.title: Rehragout-Rendezvous / Rehragout-Rendezvous

However, the missing person soon developed into a tricky murder case when a crook with a human ear appears in the beak. / Im vorweihnachtlichen Niederkaltenkirchen beschlieSSt Oma, fortan mehr zu entspannen und das Kochen und Backen aufzugeben. programme.title: Football - Wwin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Founded in 2000, the Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest rank of football competitions in BiH. With the entry of cubes from Republika Srpska, two years later, the league receives a format with 16 clubs in the two -round competition system. Today, 12 clubs compete in the league, which after 22 rounds are divided into the Champions League and League to stay. The first historic champion of BiH was Leotar from Trebinje. The club with the highest championship titles Zrinjski is from Mostar. The greatest European success is the placement of Željezničar in the UEFA semi -finals in 1984. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football - Romania League / Fudbal - Rumunjska liga
programme.desc: Romania's first football league has a long history, the first season has been played back in 1909. year when the first title won the extinguished Olympi Bucharest today. Throughout history, the undisputed rulers of this league are Steau and Dinamo from Bucharest who took most of the title of champions. The League currently has 14 clubs and after "regular" work, where everyone plays one game at home and one in the guests, the league is divided into two parts. The first part is play off for the champion where six best clubs are participated as the rest is struggling in a special part for survival. / Prva fudbalska liga Rumunije ima dugačku istoriju, prva sezona je odigrana davne 1909. godine kada je prvu titulu osvojila danas ugašena Olimpija Bukurešt. Kroz istoriju neprikosnoveni vladari ove lige su Steaua i Dinamo iz Bukurešta koji su uzeli većinu titula šampiona. Trenutno liga broji 14 klubova i nakon "regularnog" dela, gdje svako sa svakim igra po jednu utakmicu na domaćem terenu i jednu u gostima, liga se deli na dva dijela. Prvi dio je play off za šampiona gde učestvuje šest najbolje plasiranih klubova dok se ostatak bori u posebnom delu za opstanak.

programme.title: Football - Argentine League / Fudbal - Argentinska liga
programme.desc: The first country outside the United Kingdom established its football league is Argentina. It was ancivered in 1891. years and the right to play only teams from Buenos Ayres and Rosari. 1931. year when 18 clubs moved from amateur to professional ranking Argentine League, he received the forerunner of his present version. Since 2014. The League has 30 teams that fight the title of Argentina in a single round system. The highest title counts the legendary river salaries from Buenos Aires, but his biggest rival of Bok Juniors follows him. / Prva zemlja izvan Ujedinjenog Kraljevstva koja je uspostavila svoju fudbalsku ligu je Argentina. Bilo je to davne 1891. godine te su pravo nastupa imale samo ekipe iz Buenos Ajresa i Rosarija. 1931. godine kada 18 klubova prelazi iz amaterskog u profesionalni rang argentinska liga dobija preteču svoje današnje verzije. Od 2014. godine liga broji 30 ekipa koje se u jednokružnom sistemu bore za titulu prvaka Argentine. Najviše titula broji legendarni River Plate iz Buenos Ajresa ali ga u stopu prati i njegov najveći rival Boka Juniors.

programme.title: FBBAL - Italian League / Fudbal - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: Italian series and is a professional football competition that counts 20 teams in the two-circular league championship. Since 1929, when she was founded, a series A became synonymous with tactical football. For many years, Italian football has considered the best in Europe with its quality and a series of great players and trainers. With the fall of the financial power of Italian first league and a series of corruption scandals, the league briefly fell in quality but is returned to the place where it belongs. / Italijanska Serija A profesionalno je fudbalsko takmičenje koje broji 20 momčadi u dvokružnom ligaškom prvenstvu. Još od 1929. godine kada je osnovana, Serija A je postala sinonim za taktički fudbal. Dugi niz godina italijanski se fudbal svojom kvalitetom te nizom sjajnih igrača i trenera smatrao najboljim u Evropi. Padom finansijske moći italijanskih prvoligaša te nizom korupcijskih skandala liga je nakratko pala u kvaliteti ali se sigurnim koracima vraća na mjesto gdje i pripada.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - Spanish League / Fudbal - Španska liga
programme.desc: Primera or popular La Liga is the first Spanish football league. With as many as 22 conquered titles of the European Primary Champion, the Spanish Primera for years are considered the best European football league. Founded in 1929. year, the example counts 20 teams that in 38 cars are trying to collect the largest number of points. This is the most path to go to Madrid Real, while the other is the most successful Team Barcelona. With top teams of Spanish league, it adorns and extremely technical mentality of the game mostly clubs with the aim of overcoming opponents. / Primera ili popularno La Liga prva je španska fudbalska liga. Sa čak 22 osvojene titule prvaka Evrope španska Primera godinama se smatra najboljom evropskom fudbalskom ligom. Osnovana 1929. godine, Primera broji 20 ekipa koje u 38 kola sezone pokušavaju skupiti najveći broj bodova. To je najviše puta pošlo za rukom madridskom Realu dok je druga najuspješnija ekipa Barselona. Uz vrhunske ekipe špansku ligu krasi i izrazito tehnički mentalitet igre većine klubova sa ciljem za nadigravanjem protivnika.

programme.title: Basketball - Serbian League / Košarka - Srpska liga
programme.desc: Serbia has its first basketball league as the highest rank of professional basketball in that country. The League itself was founded in 2006. and as such as 14 teams. The competition takes place according to the subcircular point system and in mutual meetings each club hosts one time and by one guest. It is interesting in this part of the competition, Serbian clubs playing in this part of the competition, which play the regional ABA league. After the first part of the four best clubs are placed in the Super League in which clubs that played a regional competition are placed only then and in that phase, the Champions of Serbia is decided. The number of clubs that will be placed in the Super League depends on the number of representatives in the regional league, but in that part of the competition, there are always 8 teams. / Srbija ima svoju prvu košarkašku ligu kao najviši rang profesionalne košarke u toj zemlji. Sama liga osnovana je 2006. godine i kao takva broji 14 timova. Takmičenje se odvija po dvokružnom bod sistemu te je u međusobnim susretima svaki klub jedan put domaćin i po jednom gost. Zanimljivost je što u ovom delu takmičenja ne nastupaju i srpski klubovi koji igraju regionalnu ABA ligu. Nakon prvog dela četiri najbolja kluba se plasiraju u Superligu u kojoj se tek tada priključuju klubovi koji su igrali regionalno takmičenje i u toj fazi se odlučuje o prvaku Srbije. Broj klubova koji će se plasirati u Superligu zavisi o broju predstavnika u regionalnoj ligi, no u tom delu takmičenja se uvek nalazi 8 timova.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA League / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA League was established by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such consists of clubs from the space of the former SFRY and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic were still involved in it. On several occasions, it has changed the name depending on the sponsor, and today is the official name "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place by playing two games, each with each, one on the domestic and one on the away field, ie by the two-circular league system. The second part of the competition or playoffs differed from the season by season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Football: France 2. League / Fudbal: Francuska 2. liga
programme.desc: Ligue 2 The second is on the Niou class of French club football competitions. League was founded in 1933. year and in today's format has a total of 20 clubs. The league part consists of 38 cars in which each team at home and plays with every one of the remaining clubs in the league. The two best placed teams achieve a direct placement in Ligue 1 while another three clubs through additional playing hunts another position for the placement in the elite grade of French football. The two last teams fall out in the lower rank of competition. / Ligue 2 drugi je po niou razred francuskih klupskih fudbalskih takmičenja. Liga je osnovana 1933. godine i u današnjem formatu broji ukupno 20 klubova. Ligaški deo sastoji je od 38 kola u kojima svaka ekipa kod kuće i u gostima igra sa svakim od preostalih klubova u ligi. Dve najbolje plasirane ekipe ostvaruju direktna plasman u Ligue 1 dok još tri kluba kroz dodatno razigravanje lovi još jednu poziciju za plasman u elitni razred francuskog fudbala. Dve poslednje ekipe ispadaju u niži rang takmičenja.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: Croatian football league (HNL) was founded in 1992. year and the first historical title won Split Hajduk. Through years, the system of competition and the number of clubs changed but in recent years, today's system with 10 teams and the four-round form of the competition. The transition cup intended to champion is the work of the academic sculptor Marijana earns. He won him in Zagreb Dinamo mostly. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - Superliga Serbia / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Super League has had its premiere in the 2006/2007 season. In today's league system, there are 20 teams and functions on the two-circular principle of competition. The history of the Super League was largely marked by two large Belgrade Rivals, Partizan and Red Star. Historically, according to the number of titles, the red-white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football - Romania League / Fudbal - Rumunjska liga
programme.desc: Romania's first football league has a long history, the first season has been played back in 1909. year when the first title won the extinguished Olympi Bucharest today. Throughout history, the undisputed rulers of this league are Steau and Dinamo from Bucharest who took most of the title of champions. The League currently has 14 clubs and after "regular" work, where everyone plays one game at home and one in the guests, the league is divided into two parts. The first part is play off for the champion where six best clubs are participated as the rest is struggling in a special part for survival. / Prva fudbalska liga Rumunije ima dugačku istoriju, prva sezona je odigrana davne 1909. godine kada je prvu titulu osvojila danas ugašena Olimpija Bukurešt. Kroz istoriju neprikosnoveni vladari ove lige su Steaua i Dinamo iz Bukurešta koji su uzeli većinu titula šampiona. Trenutno liga broji 14 klubova i nakon "regularnog" dela, gdje svako sa svakim igra po jednu utakmicu na domaćem terenu i jednu u gostima, liga se deli na dva dijela. Prvi dio je play off za šampiona gde učestvuje šest najbolje plasiranih klubova dok se ostatak bori u posebnom delu za opstanak.

programme.title: I am… / Аз съм…
programme.desc: "I am" is a short portrait form that presents interesting and talented young people who appear in different fields - athletes, artists, artists, singers. The purpose of the section is to promote the achievements of the young and active part of our society. / "Аз съм" е кратка портретна форма, която представя интересни и талантливи млади хора, изявяващи се в различни области – спортисти, артисти, художници, певци. Целта на рубриката е да популяризира постиженията на младата и активна част от нашето общество.

programme.title: Sailing: Grand Prix of Britain / Ветроходство: Гран при на Великобритания
programme.desc: The event is held in Portsmouth, UK. 12 national teams with high -speed F50, up to 100 km/h, participate. In this type of competition they are not winning the technology of the vessel, but the crew and the strategy. / Събитието се провежда в Портсмут, Великобритания. Участват 12 национални отбора с високоскоростни катамарани тип F50, достигащи до 100 км/ч. В този вид състезание побеждават не технологията на плавателния съд, а екипажът и стратегията.

programme.title: European Athletics Championships for adolescents and girls under 20 / Европейско първенство по лека атлетика за юноши и девойки до 20 г.
programme.desc: The European Athletics Championship for adolescents and girls under 20 is a competition aimed at developing talents in this age group. programme.title: Myths and legends / Митове и легенди
programme.desc: Dragons are an integral part of the mythologies of different cultures and civilizations. But, it seems that England has the most legends and myths dedicated to these monsters. The bloodthirsty is probably the most famous water dragon. This episode introduces his story. / Драконите са неразделна част от митологиите на различните култури и цивилизации. Но, като че ли Англия има най-много легенди и митове посветени на тези чудовища. Кръвожадният Накър е вероятно най-известният воден дракон. Този епизод запознава с неговата история.

programme.title: World Cup by Modern Pentel: Finale / Световна купа по модерен петобой: Финал
programme.desc: World Cup in Modern Pentel - a sport that combines 5 completely different sports: fencing, shooting, swimming, running and equestrian. / Световна купа по модерен петобой - спорт, който комбинира 5 напълно различни един от друг спорта: фехтовка, стрелба, плуване, бягане и конен спорт.

programme.title: Woody Allen's panorama: like everything else / Панорама на Уди Алън: Като всичко останало
programme.desc: Jerry Folk is an ambitious writer who has a psychological problem. He can't leave people in his life who obviously interferes with him. But for joy, one day he meets Dobel /Woody Allen /, who, with a tongue, is an absurd philosophy of being, helps him part with his psychoanalyst, his agent and his girlfriend at once - for good or for evil ... / Джери Фолк е амбициозен писател, който има психологически проблем. Не може да напуска хората в живота си, които очевидно му пречат. Но за радост, един ден среща Добел /Уди Алън/, който със воята абсурдна философия за битието, му помага да се раздели с психоаналитика си, агента си и приятелката си наведнъж - за добро или за зло...

Kolijevka totalnog nogometa iz sezone u sezonu oduševljava nas neizvjesnim te efikasnim susretima.

programme.title: Spirit of Yachting: TP52 WC / Spirit of Yachting: TP52 WC
programme.desc: Sailing is a special sport, there is a more important tactic and mental strength from physical. These people must always think at least three steps in advance, and every mistake can be fatal. / Jedrenje je poseban sport, bitnija je taktika i mentalna snaga od fizičke. Ovi ljudi moraju da misle uvek bar tri koraka unapred, a svaka greška može da bude kobna.

programme.title: Football - Austrian League: Sturm - Rapid / Nogomet - Austrijska liga: Sturm - Rapid
programme.desc: Founded in 1974, Austrian Bundesliga has 10 clubs in the four -round competition system. Viennese Rapid has the most won titles. / Osnovana 1974. godine austrijska Bundesliga broji 10 klubova u četverokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Najviše osvojenih naslova ima bečki Rapid.

programme.title: Maraton: Gold Coast - pregled / Maraton: Gold Coast - pregled
programme.desc: Follow the marathon that is held every year in the coastal Australian city Gould Koust. The first edition of this race was held in 1979. years. / Pratite maraton koji se svake godine održava u priobalnom australijskom gradu Gould Koust. Prvo izdanje ove trke održano je 1979. godine.

programme.title: Golden Goals Yu Sports / Zlatni golovi YU sporta
programme.desc: There are many great moments in the history of Yugoslav football, and we have singled out only the best of the best. It is always nice to remember these beautiful moments. / Mnogo je velikih momenata u istoriji jugoslovenskog fudbala, a mi smo izdvojili samo najbolje od najboljeg. Uvek je lepo setiti se tih lepih trenutaka.

programme.title: Football - Slovenian 1. Liga: Primorje - Maribor / Fudbal - Slovenačka 1. liga: Primorje - Maribor
programme.desc: In previous seasons, we watched very interesting championships in Slovenia and received surprising outcomes. Will this be the case this season? / Prethodnih sezona gledali smo veoma zanimljiva prvenstva u Sloveniji i dobijali iznenađujuće ishode. Da li će tako biti i ove sezone?

programme.title: Stage of stars / Omaž zvezdama
programme.desc: Boxers, football players, basketball players ... The best athletes of all time, from all sports. In the same place, at the same time, how to compare them and how to make eternal lists. / Bokseri, fudbaleri, košarkaši... Najbolji sportisti svih vremena, iz svih sportova. Na istom mestu, u isto vreme, kako ih uporediti i kako napraviti večne liste.

programme.title: Fudbal - Bundesliga 2: Hertha - Karlsruher / Fudbal - Bundesliga 2: Hertha - Karlsruher
programme.desc: The popular "Cweit" seems to have never been stronger. Who will return from the greats to the first league? There are few places and a lot of candidates. / Popularna "Cvajta" čini se, nikada nije bila jača. Ko će se od velikana vratiti u prvu ligu? Mesta je malo a kandidata mnogo.

programme.title: Basketball - a bunch of Asia (M): Guam - Japan / Košarka - Kup Azije (M): Guam - Japan
programme.desc: National teams from the Asian continent - including Australia and New Zealand, every four years competing for the title of the best in the prestigious Asian Cup. New season starts 5. August and lasts ... / Nacionalni timovi s azijskog kontinenta – uključujući i Australiju i Novi Zeland, svake se četiri godine natječu za titulu najboljeg u prestižnom Kupu Azije. Nova sezona započine 5. kolovoza i traje...

programme.title: Live choice / Uži izbor
programme.desc: The best athletes of all time, from all sports. In the same place, at the same time, how to compare them and how to make eternal lists. Someone will try what the decades talk about ... / Najbolji sportisti svih vremena, iz svih sportova. Na istom mestu, u isto vreme, kako ih uporediti i kako napraviti večne liste. programme.title: Forgotten / Zaboravljeni
programme.desc: George is a mentally ill homeless man who has not been able to keep his job for years. Wandering around the city looking for food, alcohol and shelter. He is trying to get in touch with his alienated daughter. As time goes on, George tries to use some of the social services provided by the City of New York, but there are no appropriate documents to get financial assistance. She befriends a homeless man who claims to have been a successful jazz musician and will help him repair his relationship with his beloved daughter. / George je mentalno bolesni beskućnik koji godinama nije mogao zadržati posao. Tumara gradom tražeći hranu, alkohol i sklonište. Pokušava i doći u kontakt s otuđenom kćerkom. Kako vrijeme prolazi tako George pokušava iskoristi neke od socijalnih usluga koje pruža grad New York, ali nema odgovarajuće dokumente za dobivanje financijske pomoći. Sprijatelji se s beskućnikom koji tvrdi da je bio uspješan jazz glazbenik i koji će mu pomoći u popravku odnosa s voljenom kćeri.

programme.title: Kings of Summer / Kraljevi ljeta
programme.desc: Three teenage friends, Joe, Patrick and Eskcentric and unpredictable Baiggio, in the last act of the search for independence, decide to launch the summer by building a house in the forest and living from nature. Free from the rules set by their parents, their idyllic summer soon becomes a test of their friendship, as every boy learns to appreciate the fact that the family is, whether he is the one you were born in or the one you created, something you cannot escape from. / Tri prijatelja tinejdžera, Joe, Patrick i eskcentrični i nepredvidljivi Baiggio, u posljednjem činu potrage za neovisnošći, odluče preovesti ljeto gradeći kuću u šumi i živjeti od prirode. Slobodni od pravila koje im postavljaju roditelji, njihovo idilično ljeto ubrzo postane test njihova prijateljstva, kako svaki dječak uči cijeniti činjenicu da je obitelj, bez obzira je li ona u kojoj si rođen ili ona koju si sam stvorio, nešto od čega ne možeš pobjeći.

programme.title: Kozara / Kozara
programme.desc: Kozara (1962) is the first partisan film by renowned director Veljko Bulajic, known precisely by the war epic such as the Battle of Neretva and Rat, and films that continue this topic, assassination in Sarajevo and Tito's memoirs. The adaptation is one of the most difficult battles that were fought during the Second World War on the territory of the former Yugoslavia, those on Kozari Mountain. In the summer of 1942, there was a counter -force forces of shafts that surrounded and attacked the partisans. / Kozara (1962) prvi je partizanski film poznatoga redatelja Veljka Bulajića, poznatoga upravo po ratnim epopejama kao što su Bitka na Neretvi i Rat, te filmovima koji nastavljaju tu tematiku, Atentat u Sarajevu i Titovi memoari. Adaptacija je to jedne od najtežih bitaka koje su se vodile tijekom Drugog svjetskog rata na teritoriju bivše Jugoslavije, one na planini Kozari.Tamo je u ljetu 1942. došlo do protuofenzive sila Osovine koje su opkolile i napale partizane.

programme.title: Football - Europe League / Nogomet - Europa liga
programme.desc: Europe League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and is under this name until 2009 when it was renamed the UEFA League of Europe. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and is awarded to the winner every year, which keeps him for a year ... / Europa League Highlights - (sport. program) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem UEFA-e od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja bio je Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.desc: Europe League Highlights - (Sport. Program) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe has been officially under the auspices of UEFA since 1971. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Fair Cup, which was played from 1955 to 1971. During the years, the format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group competition was introduced after which elimination followed. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim je nazivom sve do 2009. godine kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Europe. Tokom godina format se nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedeno je natjecanje po skupinama nakon kojeg slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake se godine dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.desc: UEFA Champions League - (Sport. Program, 2025) at the proposal of French journalist Gabriel Hanot in 1955, a championship Cup was founded, an annual continental competition in which only the champions of their countries compete. In 1992, the media popularization of this format was founded by the UEFA Champions League, a competition for all the best clubs in Europe. Clubs are placed in the Champions League by the result at the league competitions of their country. The Champions League finals became the most watched football event on the planet. The highest European championship titles have a Madrid giant Real ... / UEFA Champions League - (sport. program, 2025) Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno natjecanje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, natjecanje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom na ligaškim natjecanjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti. Najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Europe broji madridski velikan Real...

programme.title: Lazio - Plzen, Football, Europa League / Lazio - Plzen, Nogomet, Europa liga
programme.desc: Football: UEFA Europa League - (Sport. Program, 2025) The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the 1971 European Football Federation. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was the Cup of Fair cities that played from 1955 to 1971. Since that season, the competition has been officially called the UEFA Cup and under that name until 2009. When it was renamed the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the competition format has changed several times, and since the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which elimination followed. The trophy for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972 for the UEFA Cup finals by Italian artist Bertoni and every year is awarded to the winner who keeps him for a year ... / Football: UEFA Europa League - (sport. program, 2025) Drugo najprestižnije klupsko nogometno natjecanje u Europi je službeno pod okriljem Europske nogometne federacije UEFE of 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog natjecanja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone natjecanje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Europa Ligu. Tijekom godina se sam format natjecanja nekoliko puta mijenjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slijede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobjednika ovog natjecanja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane talijanskog umjetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodjeljuje pobjedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana...

programme.desc: Football - SuperSport HNL - (Sports. Program, Croatia, 2025) Follow the SuperSport Croatian Football League, the football competition of the highest rank in Croatia, which has been held since 1992 under the leadership of the Croatian Football Federation. By 2022, the league was named the first Croatian football league. The top ten football clubs from Croatia participate in the Supersport HNL. The club that is crowned with the title of national champion has the opportunity to try in the 2nd round of the UEFA Champions League, while runner -up and third -placed entering the 2nd round of qualifying for the UEFA European Conference League ... / Football - SuperSport HNL - (sport. program, Hrvatska, 2025) Pratite SuperSport hrvatsku nogometnu ligu, nogometno natjecanje najvišeg ranga u Hrvatskoj koje se održava od 1992. godine pod vodstvom Hrvatskoga nogometnog saveza. Liga je do 2022. godine nosila naziv Prva hrvatska nogometna liga. U SuperSport HNL-u sudjeluje deset najboljih nogometnih klubova iz Hrvatske. Klub koji se okruni titulom državnoga prvaka ima priliku okušati se u 2. pretkolu UEFA Lige prvaka, dok drugoplasirani i trećeplasirani ulaze u 2. pretkolo kvalifikacija za UEFA Europsku konferencijsku ligu...

programme.title: Murder night / Mordnacht
programme.desc: One for everyone, all for one! This is the motto in the tranquil Heiterstorf at the gates of Hamburg. In order to be able to be accepted again in his hometown, which Gabriel Panski (Maximilian Bruckner) once freely left behind, the family man takes a spit rod. After a depressing film crack in the rowing club, the heart of Heitstorf, he is suddenly the "man of the hour". The village wants to help that Panski does not have to take a bus for a common good: the murder of the Hamburg real estate shark Butz (Jonas Hien), who wanted to pull everyone over the table. Although the money nobility dynastin Erna Gutdorf (Eva Weissenborn) scrubbed the crime scene in the rowing club, the traces drove to Panski. Commissioner Winter (Rosalie Thomass) is always one step ahead of the fortified suspect. However, she has to recognize that her perfect indicator puzzle takes a manipulated picture. When the commissioner pulls together with the suspect, she came across a perfidious vertical - and an affair by Panski's wife Anna (Claudia Kottal), which the battered preferred nothing ... / Einer fur alle, alle fur einen! So lautet das Motto im beschaulichen Heiterstorf vor den Toren Hamburgs. Um in seinem Heimatort, den Gabriel Panski (Maximilian Bruckner) einst uberheblich hinter sich gelassen hat, wieder akzeptiert zu werden, nimmt der Familienvater einen SpieSSrutenlauf auf sich. Nach einem deprimierenden Filmriss-Zechabend im Ruderclub, dem Herzen Heiterstorfs, ist er plotzlich der "Mann der Stunde". Das Dorf will mithelfen, dass Panski fur eine gemeinwohlorientierte Heldentat nicht buSSen muss: den Mord an dem Hamburger Immobilienhai Butz (Jonas Hien), der alle uber den Tisch ziehen wollte. Obwohl die Geldadel-Dynastin Erna Gutdorf (Eva WeiSSenborn) hochstpersonlich den Tatort im Ruderclub geschrubbt hat, fuhren die Spuren zu Panski. Kommissarin Winter (Rosalie Thomass) ist dem verkaterten Verdachtigen immer einen Schritt voraus. Sie muss jedoch erkennen, dass ihr perfektes Indizien-Puzzle zu einem manipulierten Bild fuhrt. Als die Kommissarin mit dem Verdachtigen an einem Strang zieht, stoSSen sie auf eine perfide Verschworung - und einen Seitensprung von Panskis Frau Anna (Claudia Kottal), von dem der Gebeutelte lieber nichts wusste ...

Researchers at the Fraunhofer Institute for short-term dynamics in Freiburg analyze the explosion pollution around the site by testing pressure. Based on city models, the team has developed software that simulates pressure wave expansion and splinter flight during a detonation. In this way, pollution agencies can be seen at the moment, which makes the evacuation of clinics, daycare centers, retirement homes and home homes better controllable, but not only on land, tons of bombs are also stored in the sea. After the end of the war, ammunition from the arsenals in the North and Baltic Sea was folded down during demilitarization. It is still stored there today - a total of around 1.6 million million tons. The problem: the interior of an aviation bomb consists of highly toxic chemicals, carcinogenic TNT, mustard gas and mercury. The bombs corrode in salt water and dismiss the toxins into the environment. A team from the Geomar Research Center has now started in the Lubecker Bay, to map the locations and scientifically examine: Where exactly is what ammunition? How big is the risk of losing explosives when recovering? What effects do the toxins have on the sea fauna? The exploration also uses camera -controlled underwater vehicles such as "Kaptn Blaubar". In fact, there is great hope in such diving robots, not only when exploring, but also when recovering the world war bombs. Completely autonomous and equipped with artificial intelligence, the underwater robot "Cuttlefish" controls through the research basin of the DFKI in Bremen. With a lot of sensors and gripping arms, he is trained to recognize and recover objects on the seabed in order to minimize the danger for people. When looking for traces, Lena is not only allowed to look at the DFKI team for maritime robotics during training the diving robot over the shoulder, but also goes on board the "alcorium". On the geomar research ship, Jens Greinert shows her with which technologies he documents the world war ammunition in the Lubeck Bay. In Oranienburg, Lena Ganschow meets the explosive master Andre Muller, who is familiar with long-term enthusiasts like no other. In Koln, she also learns from the geo-physicist Gudela von Gronefeld how blind gangs can be used underground. And what can research help free Germany from its explosive heritage? / Vor 80 Jahren ging der Zweite Weltkrieg zu Ende. Doch die gefahrlichen Spuren des Krieges lauern noch immer im Untergrund: Blindganger, die im Erdreich vor sich hin rosten. Besonders betroffen davon ist die Kleinstadt Oranienburg nordlich von Berlin. Als Sitz zahlreicher Rustungsbetriebe, wurde der Ort von den Alliierten intensiv bombardiert. Noch heute liegen hier uber 200 Weltkriegsbomben, die immer mal wieder explodieren. Hinzu kommt: In Oranienburg gibt es besonders viele Blindganger mit chemisch-mechanischem Langzeitzunder. Sie sind nicht nur eine latente Gefahr fur die Bevolkerung, sondern auch fur den Kampfmittelraumdienst. Lasst sich der Zunder entscharfen oder ist eine kontrollierte Sprengung notig? Wie weitraumig muss evakuiert werden?Lena Ganschow geht fur "ARD-Wissen" auf Spurensuche in Deutschland. Was kann die Wissenschaft leisten, um das Problem der Munitionsaltlasten zu losen? Forschende am Fraunhofer-Institut fur Kurzzeitdynamik in Freiburg analysieren durch Druckwellenversuche die Explosionsbelastung rund um den Fundort. Basierend auf Stadtmodellen hat das Team eine Software entwickelt, die die Druckwellenausbreitung und den Splitterflug bei einer Detonation simuliert. So konnen Kampfmittelraumdienste Gefahrenzonen fruhzeitig erkennen, was die Evakuierung von Kliniken, Kitas, Seniorenheimen und Wohnhausern besser steuerbar macht.Doch nicht nur an Land, auch im Meer lagern tonnenweise Bomben. Nach Kriegsende wurde bei der Entmilitarisierung Munition aus den Arsenalen in der Nord- und Ostsee verklappt. Dort lagert sie bis heute - insgesamt rund 1,6 Millionen Million Tonnen. Das Problem: Das Innenleben einer Fliegerbombe besteht aus hochgiftigen Chemikalien, aus krebserregendem TNT, Senfgas und Quecksilber. Die Bomben korrodieren im Salzwasser und entlassen die Giftstoffe in die Umwelt. Ein Team des GEOMAR-Forschungszentrums hat nun in der Lubecker Bucht, begonnen, die Fundorte zu kartieren und wissenschaftlich zu untersuchen: Wo genau liegt welche Munition? Wie groSS ist das Risiko, dass sie bei der Bergung Sprengstoff verliert? Welche Auswirkungen haben die Giftstoffe auf die Meeresfauna? Bei der Exploration kommen auch kameragesteuerte Unterwasserfahrzeuge wie "Kaptn Blaubar" zum Einsatz.Tatsachlich liegt in solchen Tauchrobotern groSSe Hoffnung, nicht nur bei der Erkundung, sondern auch bei der Bergung der Weltkriegsbomben. Komplett autonom und mit Kunstlicher Intelligenz ausgestattet, steuert der Unterwasser-Roboter "Cuttlefish" durch das Forschungsbecken des DFKI in Bremen. Bestuckt mit jeder Menge Sensoren und Greifarmen wird er darauf trainiert, selbstandig Objekte am Meeresgrund zu erkennen und zu bergen, um so die Gefahr fur den Menschen zu minimieren.Bei ihrer Spurensuche darf Lena nicht nur dem DFKI-Team fur Maritime Robotik beim Training des Tauchroboters uber die Schulter schauen, sondern geht auch an Bord der "Alkor". Auf dem GEOMAR-Forschungsschiff zeigt ihr Jens Greinert, mit welchen Technologien er die Weltkriegsmunition in der Lubecker Bucht dokumentiert.In Oranienburg trifft Lena Ganschow den Sprengmeister Andre Muller, der sich mit Langzeitzundern auskennt wie kein Zweiter. AuSSerdem erfahrt sie in Koln von der Geo-Physikerin Gudela von Gronefeld, wie sich Blindganger unterirdisch aufspuren lassen.Wie lange wird es noch dauern, bis die gefahrlichen Kriegsspuren vollstandig beseitigt sind? Und was kann die Forschung dazu beitragen, Deutschland von seinem explosiven Erbe zu befreien?

programme.title: Worldwide / WeltWeit
programme.sub-title: Kleine Ursache, groSSe Wirkung. Wie sicher ist unsere Versorgung?
programme.desc: This year - forecasting - this is supposed to overcome the business of the previous year with a turnover of 7.5 billion euros. More than the half of the goods imported into the EU come via the sea route. In good traffic between Europe and Asia - the most important trade route in the world - it is even 95 percent. A huge volume that is dependent on the functioning of the entire logistics chain. We saw how big the consequences of a story can be in March 2021: A huge container ship is fixed in the Suez Canal for six days with massive effects on world trade. In addition to blockages on the waterway to Europe, it is mainly felled into the large harbor that could go to a supply problem. In Greece, correspondent is Ernst Gelegs in the port of Piraus. The port is an interface of three continents: Europe, Asia and Africa - and thus a large capital of the country. The converting part of the huge area was sold to the Chinese group Cosco in 2016 and the harbors driven. China thus has the foot in the Tur of the European Union and can influence goods traffic. Around 40,000 ships pass the Bosphorus in the Turkei. Correspondent Katharina Wagner accompanies one of the Bosphorus pilots in his challenging work. Driving through the meters in Istanbul is anything but easy, especially for several hundred meter long cargo ships and oil tankers. They are urgently encouraged to help the help of experienced ship slots. A ship's accident on the Bosphorus has been very much illustrated by numerous deliveries to Europe. In the Netherlands, correspondent Raffaela Schai rider gets an exclusive insight into Europe's greatest harbor. The entire logistics is minutia. Everything has to be efficient and quick, so all areas are highly digitized. The port itself and the companies that work on the landing. But the high degree of digitization makes the port of Rotterdam vulnerable for cyber attacks. Attacks on the IT system of a single company has consequences for the entire port: If a logistics company is hacked, ships cannot be unloaded, goods remain in the containers, the logistics chain is interrupted. The damage to such intermediate trap quickly goes into the millions. / Das heurige Weihnachtsgeschaft soll - Prognosen zu Folge - mit einem Umsatz von 7,5 Milliarden Euro das Geschaft des Vorjahres ubertreffen. Mehr als die Halfte der in die EU importierten Waren kommen dabei uber den Seeweg. Beim Guterverkehr zwischen Europa und Asien - der wichtigsten Handelsroute der Welt - sind es sogar 95 Prozent. Ein riesiges Volumen, das vom Funktionieren der gesamten Logistikkette abhangig ist. Wie groSS die Folgen eines Storfalls sein konnen, haben wir im Marz 2021 gesehen: ein riesiges Containerschiff steckt sechs Tage im Suezkanal fest mit massiven Auswirkungen auf den Welthandel. Neben Blockaden auf den Wasserwegen nach Europa sind es vor allem Ausfalle in den groSSen Hafen, die zu einem Versorgungsproblem fuhren konnen.In Griechenland ist Korrespondent Ernst Gelegs im Hafen von Piraus unterwegs. Der Hafen ist Schnittstelle von drei Kontinenten: Europa, Asien und Afrika - und damit ein groSSes Kapital des Landes. Der uberwiegende Teil des riesigen Areals wurde 2016 an den chinesischen Konzern COSCO verkauft und das birgt Gefahren. China hat damit den FuSS in der Tur der Europaischen Union und kann den Warenverkehr beeinflussen.In der Turkei passieren rund 40.000 Schiffe jahrlich den Bosporus. Korrespondentin Katharina Wagner begleitet einen der Bosporus-Lotsen bei seiner herausfordernden Arbeit. Die Meerenge in Istanbul zu durchfahren ist alles andere als einfach, vor allem fur mehrere hundert Meter lange Frachtschiffe und Öltanker. Sie sind dringend angehalten, die Hilfe erfahrener Schiffslotsen anzunehmen. Ein Schiffsunfall am Bosporus wurde zahlreiche Lieferungen nach Europa stark verzogern.In den Niederlanden bekommt Korrespondentin Raffaela Schaidreiter einen exklusiven Einblick in Europas groSSten Hafen. Die gesamte Logistik ist minutios durchgetaktet. Alles muss effizient und schnell ablaufen, deshalb sind alle Bereiche hochdigitalisiert. Der Hafen selbst und die Firmen, die am Gelande arbeiten. Doch der hohe Grad an Digitalisierung macht den Hafen Rotterdam angreifbar fur Cyberattacken. Angriffe auf das IT-System einer einzelnen Firma hat Folgen fur den gesamten Hafen: wird ein Logistikunternehmen gehackt, konnen Schiffe nicht abladen, Ware bleibt in den Containern, die Logistikkette ist unterbrochen. Der Schaden solcher Zwischenfalle geht rasch in die Millionen.

programme.title: Eco special / Eco Spezial
programme.desc: Many people in Austria believe that they do not eat genetic engineering - especially if they use products that are marked as "organic" or "genetic engineering free". But that is not true: For decades, seeds have been changed using old genetic engineering methods - for example through radioactive radiation or chemical treatment, which even happens directly in Austria, for example in Seibersdorf near Vienna. According to the European Court of Justice, this method is considered a genetic engineering, but does not have to be marked. The reason: it can no longer be detected in the products and is considered safe. The plants that emerge from it are impossible to distinguish from nature breeded. Nevertheless, the EU Commission's proposal ensures that this new form of plant breeding for genetic engineering for genetic engineering, for horror for organic farmers, seeds and NGOs such as Greenpeace. The decision is still open - there is currently no clear majority in the EU. / Viele Menschen in Österreich glauben, keine Gentechnik zu essen - vor allem wenn sie zu Produkten greifen, die als "Bio" oder "gentechnikfrei" gekennzeichnet sind. Doch das stimmt so nicht: Seit Jahrzehnten wird Saatgut mithilfe alter Gentechnikverfahren verandert - etwa durch radioaktive Bestrahlung oder chemische Behandlung.Das passiert sogar direkt in Österreich, zum Beispiel in Seibersdorf bei Wien. Diese Methode gilt zwar laut Europaischem Gerichtshof als Gentechnik, muss aber nicht gekennzeichnet werden. Der Grund: Sie lasst sich in den Produkten nicht mehr nachweisen und gilt als sicher.Die neue Zuchtungsmethode CRISPR - die "Genschere" - ist ein viel kleinerer Eingriff in das Erbgut. Die Pflanzen, die aus ihr hervorgehen, sind unmoglich von naturnah gezuchteten Arten zu unterscheiden. Dennoch sorgt der Vorschlag der EU-Kommission, diese neue Form der Pflanzenzuchtung von den strengen Auflagen fur Gentechnik zu befreien, fur Schrecken bei Biobauern, Saatgutzuchtern und NGOs wie Greenpeace.Die Entscheidung ist noch offen - in der EU gibt es dazu derzeit keine klare Mehrheit.

Vor Sardinien liegt eine kleine Inselgruppe, zu der u.a. die Insel "La Maddalena" gehort. Der Inselarchipel war einst eine versunkene Landbrucke zwischen Sardinien und Korsika. Mehrere franzosische Eroberungsversuche scheiterten, unter anderem der von 1793, an dem damals der junge Napoleon Bonaparte teilnahm. Beruhmtheit erlangte dafur ein anderer Ort auf Sardinien - "Orgosolo" im Supramonte Gebirge. Hier zieren unzahlige Malereien, die Murales, die Hauser der Dorfbewohner und erzahlen vom Leben der Sarden, ihren sozialen Kampfen, Banditentum und Diskriminierung. Mit einem traditionellen sardischen a Capella Gesang - dem "Canto a Tenores" - dessen Wurzeln 3000 Jahre zuruckreichen und der auch UNESCO-Weltkulturerbe ist, klingt unsere Sardinien-Reise stimmungsvoll aus.

programme.title: Worldwide / WeltWeit
programme.sub-title: Kleine Ursache, groSSe Wirkung. Wie sicher ist unsere Versorgung?
programme.desc: This year - forecasting - this is supposed to overcome the business of the previous year with a turnover of 7.5 billion euros. More than the half of the goods imported into the EU come via the sea route. In good traffic between Europe and Asia - the most important trade route in the world - it is even 95 percent. A huge volume that is dependent on the functioning of the entire logistics chain. We saw how big the consequences of a story can be in March 2021: A huge container ship is fixed in the Suez Canal for six days with massive effects on world trade. In addition to blockages on the waterway to Europe, it is mainly felled into the large harbor that could go to a supply problem. In Greece, correspondent is Ernst Gelegs in the port of Piraus. The port is an interface of three continents: Europe, Asia and Africa - and thus a large capital of the country. The converting part of the huge area was sold to the Chinese group Cosco in 2016 and the harbors driven. China thus has the foot in the Tur of the European Union and can influence goods traffic. Around 40,000 ships pass the Bosphorus in the Turkei. Correspondent Katharina Wagner accompanies one of the Bosphorus pilots in his challenging work. Driving through the meters in Istanbul is anything but easy, especially for several hundred meter long cargo ships and oil tankers. They are urgently encouraged to help the help of experienced ship slots. A ship's accident on the Bosphorus has been very much illustrated by numerous deliveries to Europe. In the Netherlands, correspondent Raffaela Schai rider gets an exclusive insight into Europe's greatest harbor. The entire logistics is minutia. Everything has to be efficient and quick, so all areas are highly digitized. The port itself and the companies that work on the landing. But the high degree of digitization makes the port of Rotterdam vulnerable for cyber attacks. Attacks on the IT system of a single company has consequences for the entire port: If a logistics company is hacked, ships cannot be unloaded, goods remain in the containers, the logistics chain is interrupted. The damage to such intermediate trap quickly goes into the millions. / Das heurige Weihnachtsgeschaft soll - Prognosen zu Folge - mit einem Umsatz von 7,5 Milliarden Euro das Geschaft des Vorjahres ubertreffen. Mehr als die Halfte der in die EU importierten Waren kommen dabei uber den Seeweg. Beim Guterverkehr zwischen Europa und Asien - der wichtigsten Handelsroute der Welt - sind es sogar 95 Prozent. Ein riesiges Volumen, das vom Funktionieren der gesamten Logistikkette abhangig ist. Wie groSS die Folgen eines Storfalls sein konnen, haben wir im Marz 2021 gesehen: ein riesiges Containerschiff steckt sechs Tage im Suezkanal fest mit massiven Auswirkungen auf den Welthandel. Neben Blockaden auf den Wasserwegen nach Europa sind es vor allem Ausfalle in den groSSen Hafen, die zu einem Versorgungsproblem fuhren konnen.In Griechenland ist Korrespondent Ernst Gelegs im Hafen von Piraus unterwegs. Der Hafen ist Schnittstelle von drei Kontinenten: Europa, Asien und Afrika - und damit ein groSSes Kapital des Landes. Der uberwiegende Teil des riesigen Areals wurde 2016 an den chinesischen Konzern COSCO verkauft und das birgt Gefahren. China hat damit den FuSS in der Tur der Europaischen Union und kann den Warenverkehr beeinflussen.In der Turkei passieren rund 40.000 Schiffe jahrlich den Bosporus. Korrespondentin Katharina Wagner begleitet einen der Bosporus-Lotsen bei seiner herausfordernden Arbeit. Die Meerenge in Istanbul zu durchfahren ist alles andere als einfach, vor allem fur mehrere hundert Meter lange Frachtschiffe und Öltanker. Sie sind dringend angehalten, die Hilfe erfahrener Schiffslotsen anzunehmen. Ein Schiffsunfall am Bosporus wurde zahlreiche Lieferungen nach Europa stark verzogern.In den Niederlanden bekommt Korrespondentin Raffaela Schaidreiter einen exklusiven Einblick in Europas groSSten Hafen. Die gesamte Logistik ist minutios durchgetaktet. Alles muss effizient und schnell ablaufen, deshalb sind alle Bereiche hochdigitalisiert. Der Hafen selbst und die Firmen, die am Gelande arbeiten. Doch der hohe Grad an Digitalisierung macht den Hafen Rotterdam angreifbar fur Cyberattacken. Angriffe auf das IT-System einer einzelnen Firma hat Folgen fur den gesamten Hafen: wird ein Logistikunternehmen gehackt, konnen Schiffe nicht abladen, Ware bleibt in den Containern, die Logistikkette ist unterbrochen. Der Schaden solcher Zwischenfalle geht rasch in die Millionen.

V romarski cerkvi so organizatorji gostili številne likovne, glasbene in besedne ustvarjalce svetovnega slovesa, ki so vsako leto poskrbeli za nepozabne vecere. Ob polokroglem jubileju bomo predvajali dokumentacijo, v kateri smo se leta 2020 skupaj z iniciatorjem prireditve Janezom Gregoricem ozrli na viške kreativne ustavarjalnosti v dveh destletjih. Potovanje skozi cas smo zaceli na kraju, kjer se je ob prestopu v novo tisocletje vse zacelo - v zgodnjekršcanskem romarskem svetišcu na gori svete Heme.Gestaltung: Marica KušejModeration: Mira Grotschnig EinspielerGesamtleitung: Marijan Velik

programme.title: Eco special / Eco Spezial
programme.desc: Many people in Austria believe that they do not eat genetic engineering - especially if they use products that are marked as "organic" or "genetic engineering free". But that is not true: For decades, seeds have been changed using old genetic engineering methods - for example through radioactive radiation or chemical treatment, which even happens directly in Austria, for example in Seibersdorf near Vienna. According to the European Court of Justice, this method is considered a genetic engineering, but does not have to be marked. The reason: it can no longer be detected in the products and is considered safe. The plants that emerge from it are impossible to distinguish from nature breeded. Nevertheless, the EU Commission's proposal ensures that this new form of plant breeding for genetic engineering for genetic engineering, for horror for organic farmers, seeds and NGOs such as Greenpeace. The decision is still open - there is currently no clear majority in the EU. / Viele Menschen in Österreich glauben, keine Gentechnik zu essen - vor allem wenn sie zu Produkten greifen, die als "Bio" oder "gentechnikfrei" gekennzeichnet sind. Doch das stimmt so nicht: Seit Jahrzehnten wird Saatgut mithilfe alter Gentechnikverfahren verandert - etwa durch radioaktive Bestrahlung oder chemische Behandlung.Das passiert sogar direkt in Österreich, zum Beispiel in Seibersdorf bei Wien. Diese Methode gilt zwar laut Europaischem Gerichtshof als Gentechnik, muss aber nicht gekennzeichnet werden. Der Grund: Sie lasst sich in den Produkten nicht mehr nachweisen und gilt als sicher.Die neue Zuchtungsmethode CRISPR - die "Genschere" - ist ein viel kleinerer Eingriff in das Erbgut. Die Pflanzen, die aus ihr hervorgehen, sind unmoglich von naturnah gezuchteten Arten zu unterscheiden. Dennoch sorgt der Vorschlag der EU-Kommission, diese neue Form der Pflanzenzuchtung von den strengen Auflagen fur Gentechnik zu befreien, fur Schrecken bei Biobauern, Saatgutzuchtern und NGOs wie Greenpeace.Die Entscheidung ist noch offen - in der EU gibt es dazu derzeit keine klare Mehrheit.

programme.title: The race for the atomic bomb / Der Wettlauf um die Atombombe
programme.desc: On the occasion of the 80th anniversary of the atomic bombing on Hiroshima and Nagasaki on August 6 and 9, 1945, Universe History is devoted to the history of a group of six people, whose names still have meaning. Their inventions and work changed the course of the history of the 20th century. Six friends, all from the same city, extraordinarily talented and stubborn. You have to leave Europe, one by one. The goal: the United States of America. Each of them gains worldwide recognition. The research and scientific achievements by John von Neumann, Edward Teller, Eugene Paul Wigner and Leo Szilard were crucial for the invention of the atomic bomb and modern warming as we know them. Robert Capa became the most based on the world. And Michael Curtiz film "Casablanca" is one of the most iconic propaganda films of all time. In individual and collectively, these Hungarian Jews explain war to totalitarianism. Everyone in their own way, but all with the same goal, the same mission and the same enemy. None of them wanted to give up Europe without a fight. Head: Thomas Ammann, Judith Lentzeproduction: Prununen Film, Nordmedia Fonds GBMH, Hungarian Film Fund, the Federal Government Commissioner for Culture and Media / Anlasslich des 80. Jahrestages der Atombombenabwurfe auf Hiroshima und Nagasaki am 6. und 9. August 1945 widmet sich Universum History der Geschichte einer Gruppe von sechs Menschen, deren Namen bis heute Bedeutung tragen. Ihre Erfindungen und Arbeiten veranderten den Verlauf der Geschichte des 20. Jahrhunderts. Sechs Freunde, alle aus derselben Stadt, auSSerst talentiert und eigensinnig. Sie mussen Europa verlassen, einer nach dem anderen. Das Ziel: Die Vereinigten Staaten von Amerika. Jeder von ihnen erlangt weltweite Anerkennung.Die Forschung und wissenschaftlichen Errungenschaften von John von Neumann, Edward Teller, Eugene Paul Wigner und Leo Szilard waren entscheidend fur die Erfindung der Atombombe und der modernen Kriegsfuhrung, wie wir sie kennen. Robert Capa wurde zum beruhmtesten Kriegsfotografen der Welt. Und Michael Curtiz Film "Casablanca" gilt als einer der ikonischsten Propagandafilme aller Zeiten.Individuell und kollektiv erklarten diese ungarischen Juden dem Totalitarismus den Krieg. Jeder auf seine eigene Weise, aber alle mit dem gleichen Ziel, der gleichen Mission und dem gleichen Feind. Keiner von ihnen wollte Europa kampflos aufgeben.Regie: Thomas Ammann, Judith LentzeProduktion: Prounen Film, nordmedia Fonds GbmH, Hungarian Filmfonds, Der Beauftragte der Bundesregierung fur Kultur und Medien

programme.title: Hiroshima - end of war or war crimes? / Hiroshima - Kriegsende oder Kriegsverbrechen?
programme.desc: The ORF III time history devotes a comprehensive focus to the 80th anniversary of the atomic bombing of Hiroshima and Nagasaki. May 1945: The war is finally over in Europe, but the Pacific War between the USA and Japan continues to rage with undiminished hard. The United States contested that only an extraordinary invasion of Japan can end the war. But the development of a new miracle weapon with indescribable destruction is opened up a new option: the atomic bomb and actually: After the bombs dropped to Hiroshima and Nagasaki on August 6 and 9, 1945 with a total of well more than 100,000, main civilian victims, it doesn't take a month before Japan's Emperor Hirohito was fully cap This is not just a matter of time and therefore not immediately result of the atomic bombing? Has Japan soon surrendered to Hiroshima and Nagasaki without hundreds of thousands of crowded civilians in Hiroshima and Nagasaki without hundreds of thousands of the Soviet Union? And why, after dropping the first bomb, which showed the immense destruction of the atomic bomb, was even thrown down? / Die ORF III-Zeitgeschichte widmet dem 80. Jahrestag der Atombombenabwurfe auf Hiroshima und Nagasaki einen umfassenden Schwerpunkt.Mai 1945: in Europa ist der Krieg endgultig vorbei, doch der Pazifikkrieg zwischen den USA und Japan tobt mit unverminderter Harte weiter. Die USA befurchten, dass erst eine auSSerst verlustreiche Invasion Japans den Krieg beenden kann. Doch die Entwicklung einer neuen Wunderwaffe mit unbeschreiblicher Zerstorungskraft eroffnet eine neue Option: die Atombombe.Und tatsachlich: nach dem Abwurf der Bomben auf Hiroshima und Nagasaki am 6. und 9. August 1945 mit insgesamt weit mehr als 100.000, hauptsachlichen zivilen Opfern dauert es nicht einmal mehr ein Monat, ehe Japans Kaiser Hirohito am 2. September die vollstandige Kapitulation verkundet.Doch war dies nicht ohnehin nur eine Frage der Zeit und demnach nicht unmittelbar Resultat der Atombombenabwurfe? Hatte Japan angesichts des Kriegseintrittes der Sowjetunion nicht auch ohne hunderttausende getotete Zivilisten in Hiroshima und Nagasaki bald kapituliert? Und weshalb wurde nach dem Abwurf der ersten Bombe, die die immense Zerstorungskraft der Atombombe zeigte, sogar noch eine weitere abgeworfen?Die Dokumentation folgt in packenden Bildern jenen todbringenden Tagen im Sommer 1945 - und versucht auch die Frage nach dem tatsachlichen Nutzen der verheerenden Atombombenabwurfe zu beantworten.

programme.title: Lise Meitner - The mother of the atomic bomb / Lise Meitner - Die Mutter der Atombombe
programme.desc: She was the second woman in Austria, the studied and one of the most brilliant scientists who had ever produced the country - a pioneer in every respect: Lise Meitner, a woman who was far ahead of her own time. The central conflict of the documentation is that between a modern woman and a society that offered no field of activity for women away from the family. For the film, this means that he is extremely close to the life story of Lise Meitner and thus emphasizes her double pioneering performance: as a researcher and as a pioneer of the women's movement. In doing so, she always focuses on resistance - be they political or private nature - and, despite or perhaps because of all disadvantages, develops into a self -confident scientist. Lise Meitner's changeable life not only raises an exemplary history of the disadvantage of women in science and research, but is also the drama of a pacifist, which through her beloved work, is the basis for the deathliest weapon of all time: Wolf von Truchsess. / Sie war die zweite Frau in Österreich, die studierte und eine der genialsten Wissenschafterinnen, die das Land je hervorgebracht hatte - ein Pionierin in jeder Beziehung: Lise Meitner, eine Frau, die ihrer eigenen Zeit weit voraus war. Der zentrale Konflikt der Dokumentation ist der zwischen einer modernen Frau und einer Gesellschaft, die fur Frauen abseits der Familie keinerlei Betatigungsfeld bot. Fur den Film bedeutet dies, dass er sich extrem nah mit der Lebensgeschichte Lise Meitners beschaftigt und so ihre gleich doppelte Pionierleistung herausstellt: Als Forscherin und als Vorreiterin der Frauenbewegung. Dabei stoSSt sie immer wieder auf Widerstande - seien sie politischer oder privater Natur - und entwickelt sich trotz oder gerade wegen aller Benachteiligungen wegen Geschlecht und Religion zu einer selbstbewussten Wissenschaftlerin. Lise Meitners wechselvolles Leben erzahlt nicht nur eine exemplarische Geschichte uber die Benachteiligung von Frauen in Wissenschaft und Forschung, sondern ist vor dem historischen Hintergrund der Shoa auch das Drama einer Pazifistin, die durch ihre geliebte Arbeit die Grundlage fur die todlichste Waffe aller Zeit schuf.Regie: Wolf von Truchsess

programme.desc: Although reservoirs have all been created, they are considered pearls of the Alps in many places. The Schlegeis reservoir in the Zillertal has become a global attraction, it is a social media hotspot for hundreds of people a day. And many a lake is not known to many as a source of drive of a hydropower plant, like the greatest lake in Tyrol: the Achensee. At the beginning of the 20th century, he created a masterpiece in the nearby Jenbach. The driving force of reservoirs and power plants is water, an unexpected and drafty power that has created exciting stories. (Doku 2022) / Obwohl Stauseen alle kunstlich entstanden sind, gelten sie vielerorts als Perlen der Alpen. Jahrhunderts im nahe gelegenen Jenbach eine ingenieurtechnische Meisterleistung entstehen lassen. Funf photos were taken on August 6, 1945 in the near the epicenter of the atomic bombing. They are the only received documents that show the reactions of the residents of Hiroshima shortly before the attack. With the help of the latest technology, the scenes will restore and the still images will bring to life with animations. The film is a mixture of impressive archive material from Hiroshima in front of the tragty and intellectual interviews with survivors of the atomic bomb explosion. The documentation reconstructs the events of that day and follows the personal stories of individual people who desperately tried to overcome the inferno. / Am 6. August 2025 jahrt sich zum 80. Aber was geschah an jenem Tag unter der Hiroshima-Wolke?Funf Fotos wurden am 6. August 1945 in der Nahe des Epizentrums des Atombombenabwurfs aufgenommen. Sie sind die einzigen erhaltenen Dokumente, welche die Reaktionen der Einwohner von Hiroshima in dem Moment kurz vor dem Angriff zeigen. Der Film ist eine Mischung aus beeindruckendem Archivmaterial von Hiroshima vor der Tragodie und gefuhlsergreifenden Interviews mit Überlebenden der Atombombenexplosion. Die Dokumentation rekonstruiert die Ereignisse jenes Tages und verfolgt die personlichen Geschichten einzelner Menschen, die verzweifelt versuchten das Inferno zu uberleben.
