programme.title: Black Box - dangerous truth / Black Box - Gefahrliche Wahrheit
programme.desc: After a plane crash in the Alps, the young Black-Box analyst Mathieu quickly fell on the supposed cause of the trot up. But soon he will come to him as a result of new evidence. In order to remove the truth, he risks his life and mind. The only thing is the voice recorder of the machine's voice recorder in the French Alps. After the traceless disappearance of the actual investigation manager, Victor Pollock (Olivier Rabourd), Philippe Renier (Andre Dussollier), head of the French investigation behavior for flight unfall, entrusts the Black-Box analyst Mathieu Vasseur (Pierre Niney) with the case. The young expert quickly isolates an on -board recording that indicates an Islamist act of terrorist. The suspicion is made public. However, the evaluation of mobile phone data from the surrounding area of the disposable Gerat Mathieu into doubt. When he learns that Pollock was not able to get the voice recorder alone before his disappearance, he collapsed in his house. Mathieu finds video recordings of secret meetings between Pollock and the entrepreneur Xavier Renaud (Sebastien Pouderoux), whose company designs computer security systems for aircraft - also for the manufacturer of the unexposure machine. Mathieu reports that the assistance system built into the stored machine was considered unexpected. Mathieu obtains about the laptop of his wife Noemie (Lou de Laâge), who works for the agency for aviation and space safety, sensitive documents for the bumpy test process of the flight assistance system. He dangerously threatens Noemie's job - and his marriage. With the documents, Mathieu obtains further tests at renier, which, however, remain unsuccessful. He suspects that the voice recorder was exchanged. Mathieu is released, but continues to investigate and soon discovers a new trace. Flight tap, Bea, was accompanied by which director Yann Gozlan and his team were available to advise both with the script and the set. With a precise image and sound design, the film approaches its milieu of aviation and its technical induction in detail. The tension of the cinema tite, which clearly cracked the million mark in France, is in no way inferior to his authenticity claim. Niney was inspired by the observation of a real black box analysts, among other things, and by Gene Hackman's figure from Francis Ford Coppola's genre classic "The Dialogue". / Nach einem Flugzeugabsturz in den Alpen stoSSt der junge Black-Box-Analyst Mathieu schnell auf die vermeintliche Ursache der Tragodie. Doch bald kommen ihm infolge neuer Beweise Zweifel.Mathieu setzt seine Untersuchungen eigenmachtig fort und dringt dabei in die korrupten Abgrunde der von achtlosen Wirtschaftsinteressen geleiteten Luftfahrtindustrie vor. Um die Wahrheit zu enthullen, riskiert er sein Leben und seinen Verstand.Infolge des Absturzes eines Passagierflugzeugs in den franzosischen Alpen wird einzig der Stimmenrekorder der Maschine unversehrt geborgen. Nach dem spurlosen Verschwinden des eigentlichen Ermittlungsleiters, Victor Pollock (Olivier Rabourdin), betraut Philippe Renier (Andre Dussollier), Leiter der franzosischen Untersuchungsbehorde fur Flugunfalle, den Black-Box-Analysten Mathieu Vasseur (Pierre Niney) mit dem Fall. Schnell isoliert der junge Experte eine Bordaufzeichnung, die auf einen islamistischen Terrorakt hindeutet. Der Verdacht wird publik gemacht.Durch die Auswertung von Handydaten aus dem Umfeld der Verungluckten gerat Mathieu jedoch ins Zweifeln. Als er erfahrt, dass Pollock vor seinem Verschwinden allein mit dem Stimmenrekorder zugange war, bricht er in dessen Haus ein. Mathieu findet Videoaufnahmen von Geheimtreffen zwischen Pollock und dem Unternehmer Xavier Renaud (Sebastien Pouderoux), dessen Firma Computersicherheitssysteme fur Flugzeuge entwirft - auch fur den Hersteller der Unglucksmaschine.Ein Pilot berichtet Mathieu, dass das in der abgesturzten Maschine verbaute Assistenzsystem als unausgereift galt. Mathieu beschafft sich uber den Laptop seiner Frau Noemie (Lou de Laâge), die bei der Agentur fur Luft- und Raumfahrtsicherheit arbeitet, sensible Unterlagen zum holprigen Testvorgang des Flugassistenzsystems. Damit gefahrdet er Noemies Job - und seine Ehe.Mit den Dokumenten erwirkt Mathieu bei Renier weitergehende Tests, die allerdings ergebnislos bleiben. Er vermutet, dass der Stimmenrekorder ausgetauscht wurde. Mathieu wird freigestellt, ermittelt jedoch weiter und entdeckt bald eine neue Spur.Als er die notwendigen Beweise fur die wahre Ursache des Flugzeugabsturzes in den Handen halt, gerat er in Lebensgefahr.Dem Dreh des franzosischen Paranoia- und Wirtschaftsthrillers "Black Box - Gefahrliche Wahrheit" ging eine weitreichende Recherche voraus, die in besonderem MaSSe von Frankreichs realer Untersuchungsbehorde fur Flugunfalle, BEA, begleitet wurde, welche Regisseur Yann Gozlan und seinem Team sowohl beim Drehbuch als auch am Set beratend zur Seite stand. Mit einem prazisen Bild- und Sounddesign nahert sich der Film detailgenau seinem Milieu der Luftfahrt und ihrer technischen Aufschlusselung an.Die Spannung des Kinohits, der in Frankreich deutlich die Millionenmarke bei den Besucherinnen und Besuchern knackte, steht seinem Authentizitatsanspruch dabei in nichts nach.Die Hauptrolle des Films schrieb Gozlan dem franzosischen Schauspielstar Pierre Niney auf den Leib. Inspirieren lieSS sich Niney fur seine Darstellung unter anderem durch die Beobachtung eines realen Black-Box-Analysten und durch Gene Hackmans Figur aus Francis Ford Coppolas Genre-Klassiker "Der Dialog".

programme.title: Inspector Barnaby / Inspector Barnaby
programme.desc: On the edge of the rehearsals for a travesty show, the local council chair of the village behind the scenes is found dead - slain with a pink pitch shoe. What does the tider want to say? For DCI John Barnaby and his assistant DS Winter, complex investigations among the numerous bizarre suspects of the village. In Elverton-Cum-Latterly, rehearsals for a travesties show in the Ortliche Pub take place. The out of the 16th year Rocco Templeton (Baxter Westby)-son of the pub host Gill Templeton (Sophie Stone)-is supposed to encourage a new, costly leukamie treatment in the US (Clare Dessor) and her team give great hopes for the title. During a rehearsal of the travesties show, there is a violent word battle between Lois and Dragqueen Malik Payne (Felix Kai), which plays the leading role. Lois is found only a little later in the pub's kitchen. The recalled forensic doctor Fleur Perkins (Annette Badland) states: she was killed with a pink, sequin -placed pitch shoe; Her body is stumbled as a drag queen. The procedure can be assumed to be inspected by Inspector Barnaby (Neil Dudgeon) that the suspicion should deliberately be directed to the Dragqueens Malik Payne and Evelyn Hardy (Tessie Orange-Turner). Fell -based actors, who hopes to initiate a comeback with the Travestie show, make a secret of the fact that there was a lot of Bose's blood between them and Lois. But none of this seems to be a murder motive for inspector Barnaby and his assistant DS Jamie Winter (Nick Hendrix). In research on Lois Springfield's background Project "Romeo and Julia" of the drama teacher Olivia Dent (Suzanne Packer) had voted. For a long time, this dream of a staging of the Shakespeare classic with Nigel Bellamy as Romeo. Olivia seems to accept this defeat calmly; In any case, she only spoke to Nigel in the relaxed chat tone about her project. The evening performance of the Travestie show in front of a sold -out house seems to be a gigantic success - until another murder happens. / Am Rande der Proben fur eine Travestieshow wird die Gemeinderatsvorsitzende des Dorfes hinter den Kulissen tot aufgefunden - erschlagen mit einem pinkfarbenen Stockelschuh.Daruber hinaus wurde ihre Leiche stumperhaft als Dragqueen hergerichtet. Was will der Tater damit sagen? Fur DCI John Barnaby und seinen Assistenten DS Winter beginnen komplexe Ermittlungen unter den zahlreichen skurrilen Tatverdachtigen des Dorfes.In Elverton-cum-Latterly finden Proben fur eine Travestieshow im ortlichen Pub statt. Der Erlos soll dem 16-jahrigen Rocco Templeton (Baxter Westby) - Sohn der Pub-Wirtin Gill Templeton (Sophie Stone) - eine neuartige, kostspielige Leukamiebehandlung in den USA ermoglichen.Allerdings kollidiert diese Wohltatigkeitsveranstaltung mit dem alljahrlichen Domino-Turnier, bei dem sich vor allem Waschereibesitzerin und Gemeinderatsvorsitzende Lois Springfield (Clare Hingott) und ihr Team groSSe Hoffnungen auf den Titel machen.Wahrend einer Probe der Travestieshow kommt es zu einem heftigen Wortgefecht zwischen Lois und Dragqueen Malik Payne (Felix Kai), die die Hauptrolle spielt. Nur wenig spater wird Lois in der Kuche des Pubs ermordet aufgefunden. Die herbeigerufene Rechtsmedizinerin Fleur Perkins (Annette Badland) stellt fest: Sie wurde mit einem pinkfarbenen, paillettenbesetzten Stockelschuh erschlagen; ihre Leiche ist stumperhaft als Dragqueen hergerichtet.Die Vorgehensweise lasst Inspector Barnaby (Neil Dudgeon) annehmen, dass der Tatverdacht bewusst auf die Dragqueens Malik Payne und Evelyn Hardy (Tessie Orange-Turner) gelenkt werden sollte.Weder diese beiden noch Nigel Bellamy (Nigel Lindsay), ein im Londoner West End in Ungnade gefallener Schauspieler, der mit der Travestieshow ein Comeback einzuleiten hofft, machen einen Hehl daraus, dass es zwischen ihnen und Lois eine Menge boses Blut gab. Doch nichts von alledem scheint fur Inspector Barnaby und seinen Assistenten DS Jamie Winter (Nick Hendrix) ein Mordmotiv darzustellen.Bei Recherchen uber Lois Springfields Hintergrund zeigt sich, dass Lois bei der Abstimmung im Gemeinderat uber die Wahl des Stuckes fur die Wohltatigkeitsveranstaltung, ungeachtet ihrer Abneigung gegen Dragqueens, fur die Travestieshow und gegen das Projekt "Romeo und Julia" der Drama-Lehrerin Olivia Dent (Suzanne Packer) gestimmt hatte. Schon lange traumt diese von einer Inszenierung des Shakespeare-Klassikers mit Nigel Bellamy als Romeo. Olivia scheint diese Niederlage gelassen hinzunehmen; sie habe mit Nigel ohnehin nur im lockeren Plauderton uber ihr Projekt gesprochen.Die abendliche Vorstellung der Travestieshow vor ausverkauftem Haus scheint zu einem gigantischen Erfolg zu werden - bis ein weiterer Mord geschieht.

programme.title: Marinette - fighter. Footballer. Legend. / Marinette - Kampferin. FuSSballerin. Legende.
programme.desc: Marinette lives for her passion - football. However, broken family relationships and the lack of acceptance towards women's football always present them with challenges. The biography pursues Marinette Pichon's career from the local, French football club to the national team and their first professional contract in the USA. There she is respected as a woman in football and can be open to her homosexuality. As a girl, however, she can only live it out alone until it is actually accepted in a boy team. Her mother (Émilie dequenne) secretly understates her, because at home the family suffers from the violent excesses of the alcoholic father. The talented girl succeeds in drawing bigger clubs, and after a few years she will even be appointed to the French women's national team. But in your home country there are no professional framework for players. When Marinette gets an offer from Philadelphia, everything seems to turn to the better. In the United States, it can finally develop freely, both sporty and privately. In the world's first professional league for women's football, she receives fair payment, and she can also be open to her homosexuality. But the American dream is not permanent: their first real relationship gradually develops into a nightmare, and the game operation of the complete league is discontinued due to financial problems. Marinette returns to France, where she continues her successful career and committed herself for the rights of footballers. Marinette Pichon still belongs to the most successful footballers in France. She became a goalkeeper of the first French and the US League several times and won a championship and a trophy with the Juvisy FCF. In 2001 she became the player of the year in her home country. By 2020, the former stormer with 81 goals was the most successful goal protection of the national team. The director Virginia is reducing all facets of the main character in her film: the successful sports career with high points and jerk, as well as the not simple private life, including difficult childhood. Thus, the biography does not come to the scenes and is a gripping story of an extraordinary woman who is impressively nested by Garance Marillier with an extensive range of emotions. In addition, it is important for the filmmaker to draw attention to the disadvantage of footballers: Although a lot has improved in the structures over time and international tournaments are now medial majority; Payment is still unexpectedly bad. Only in a few countries there are real professional people who encourage players to ran out the most popular sport in the world as a profession. / Marinette lebt fur ihre Leidenschaft - den FuSSball. Doch zerruttete Familienverhaltnisse und die fehlende Akzeptanz gegenuber dem FrauenfuSSball stellen sie immer wieder vor Herausforderungen.Die Biografie verfolgt Marinette Pichons Karriere vom lokalen, franzosischen FuSSballverein bis hin zur Nationalmannschaft und ihrem ersten Profivertrag in den USA. Dort wird sie als Frau im FuSSball respektiert und kann offen zu ihrer Homosexualitat stehen.Frankreich 1980: Die kleine Marinette Pichon (Garance Marillier) entwickelt eine groSSe Leidenschaft fur FuSSball. Als Madchen kann sie diese aber zunachst nur allein ausleben, bis sie tatsachlich in einer Jungen-Mannschaft aufgenommen wird. Ihre Mutter (Émilie Dequenne) unterstutzt sie heimlich, denn zu Hause leidet die Familie unter den Gewaltexzessen des alkoholkranken Vaters.Trotz aller Hindernisse gelingt es dem talentierten Madchen, groSSere Vereine auf sich aufmerksam zu machen, und nach einigen Jahren wird sie sogar in die franzosische Frauen-Nationalmannschaft berufen. Doch in ihrem Heimatland gibt es fur Spielerinnen keine professionellen Rahmenbedingungen. Als Marinette ein Angebot aus Philadelphia bekommt, scheint sich alles zum Guten zu wenden. In den USA kann sie sich endlich frei entfalten, sowohl sportlich als auch privat.In der weltweit ersten Profiliga fur FrauenfuSSball erhalt sie eine faire Bezahlung, auSSerdem kann sie offen zu ihrer Homosexualitat stehen. Doch der amerikanische Traum ist nicht von Dauer: Ihre erste wirkliche Beziehung entwickelt sich nach und nach zum Albtraum, und der Spielbetrieb der kompletten Liga wird wegen finanzieller Probleme eingestellt. Marinette kehrt nach Frankreich zuruck, wo sie ihre erfolgreiche Karriere fortsetzt und sich fur die Rechte der FuSSballerinnen engagiert.Marinette Pichon gehort noch immer zu den erfolgreichsten FuSSballerinnen Frankreichs. Sie wurde mehrfach Torschutzenkonigin der ersten franzosischen und der US-Liga und gewann mit dem Juvisy FCF eine Meisterschaft und einen Pokal. 2001 wurde sie zur Spielerin des Jahres in ihrem Heimatland gekurt. Bis 2020 war die ehemalige Sturmerin mit 81 Treffern erfolgreichste Torschutzin der Nationalmannschaft.Die Regisseurin Virginie Verrier beleuchtet in ihrem Film ausgewogen alle Facetten der Hauptfigur: Die erfolgreiche Sportkarriere mit Hohepunkten und Ruckschlagen, sowie das nicht einfache Privatleben, inklusive der schweren Kindheit. Somit gerat die Biographie nicht zu nuchtern und prasentiert sich als packende Geschichte einer auSSergewohnlichen Frau, die von Garance Marillier mit einer umfangreichen Bandbreite an Emotionen eindrucksvoll verkorpert wird.AuSSerdem liegt es der Filmemacherin am Herzen auf die Benachteiligung der FuSSballerinnen aufmerksam zu machen: Obwohl sich im Lauf der Zeit vieles an den Strukturen verbessert hat und internationale Turniere mittlerweile mediale GroSSereignisse sind; die Bezahlung ist noch immer unverhaltnismaSSig schlecht. Nur in wenigen Landern existieren wirkliche Profiligen, die es den Spielerinnen ermoglichen, den beliebtesten Sport der Welt als Beruf auszuuben.

programme.title: No compass K2 E3 (E) / Χωρίς Πυξίδα Κ2 Ε3 (Ε)

programme.title: Jacket to get E19 (e) / Ζακέτα να Πάρεις Ε19 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Hell cousin. programme.title: Jacket to get E20 (e) / Ζακέτα να Πάρεις Ε20 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: My story, my sin. Eugenia, after some events she observes, is sure that Fouli is ready to start the song, but hides them. Η Φούλη, με τη βοήθεια του Λουκά πάντα, καταφέρνει και της ξεγλιστράει.

programme.title: 100 Years of Greek Discography E7 (E) / 100 Χρόνια Ελληνική Δισκογραφία Ε7 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: The discography in the early years of the Transition. An entire people who have been deprived of their freedom for seven years, sings again loudly. Ένας ολόκληρος λαός που στερήθηκε για επτά χρόνια την ελευθερία του, τραγουδάει και πάλι δυνατά. Οι πρέσες δεν προλάβαιναν να τυπώνουν Θεοδωράκη και όλους τους νέους δίσκους του πολιτικού τραγουδιού.

programme.title: Weekend from 5 / Σαββατοκύριακο από τις 5

programme.title: No compass K2 E4 / Χωρίς Πυξίδα Κ2 Ε4
programme.desc: PREMIERE. Episode: Samos. Penelope and Yiannis tie in the port of Samos, Kato Vathi. Η Σάμος, το μοναδικό αυτό νησί του ανατολικού Αιγαίου πελάγους, συνδυάζει οργιώδη βλάστηση, απέραντες παραλίες, καθάρια νερά και ενδιαφέροντα τουριστικά αξιοθέατα.

programme.title: Jacket to get E21 (e) / Ζακέτα να Πάρεις Ε21 (Ε)
programme.desc: Episode: Madame Pelazi. Aristea brings her sewing machine from the village, because she is bored of sitting in Athens and her reputation slowly spreads to the neighborhood. Ο Ευθύμης ψάχνει τρόπο να γλιτώσει το σαλόνι του που γίνεται ατελιέ.

(88) (transp.) / Επτά πρίγκιπες ψάχνουν την πιο ωραία κοπέλα για να σπάσουν την κατάρα που τους έχει κάνει νάνους. Στα μάτια τους αυτή είναι η Χιονάτη. programme.title: The remnants of a day / Τα Απομεινάρια μιας Μέρας

(129)

(Shekel) / הם חלמו ליצור מרחב שבו כל אחד יוכל להתבטא, אבל לא צפו את הסערות שיגיעו. כך הפכה טוויטר מסטארט-אפ מהפכני לזירת מאבק על אמת, שליטה וחופש. (שח)

programme.title: Patagonia Chapter 1 / פטגוניה פרק 1
programme.desc: A spectacular nature series takes you on a journey to a place where very few come - the southern edge of South America - Patagonia. Million a million landscapes, wildlife and fascinating human stories. 6 episodes. (Shekel) / סדרת טבע מרהיבה לוקחת אתכם למסע למקום שאליו מעט מאוד מגיעים - קצה הדרומי של דרום אמריקה - פטגוניה. מיליון קמר של נופים, חיות הבר וסיפורים אנושיים המרתקים. 6 פרקים. (שח)

programme.title: Mangla - Angel Death Chapter 1 / מנגלה - מלאך המוות פרק 1
programme.desc: Josef Mangella, the infamous and infamous Nazi physician of Auschwitz, the neighborhood angel, was able to escape after the war for South America. In the first episode of three, his first years of life are described. (Shekel) / יוזף מנגלה, הרופא הנאצי האכזרי והידוע לשמצה של אושוויץ, שכונה מלאך המוות, הצליח לברוח אחרי המלחמה לאמריקה הדרומית. בפרק הראשון מבין שלושה מתוארות שנות חייו הראשונות. (שח)

programme.title: Albums Chapter 1 / האלבומים פרק 1
programme.desc: It is not easy to be lonely in Tel Aviv, it is not easy to be a member of the Banai family, it is not easy to be 22 and it is not easy to write and compose it all ... and yet Eviatar Banai managed to write an unusual first album, but success had its price. As a bamboo (shell) / לא קל להיות בודד בתל אביב, לא קל להיות בן משפחת בנאי, לא קל להיות בן 22 ולא קל לכתוב ולהלחין את כל זה... ובכל זאת הצליח אביתר בנאי לכתוב אלבום ראשון יוצא דופן, אך להצלחה היה את המחיר שלה. כ עב (שח)

programme.title: Elizabeth Taylor's lost recordings / אליזבת טיילור הקלטות האבודות
programme.desc: An unveiled interviews with legendary actress Elizabeth Taylor, with unprecedented access to her personal archive that reveals her complex inner life. HBO 2024 (S.) / ראיונות שטרם נחשפו עם השחקנית האגדית אליזבת טיילור, תוך גישה חסרת תקדים לארכיון האישי שלה החושף את חייה הפנימיים המורכבים. HBO 2024 (שח)

programme.title: parent / הורה
programme.desc: Dukabiv 2025. A century for parent a journey following the people's dancing as a parable to Israeli, from the dream of creating a new Hebrew culture to the fight for a joint identity in today's Israeli society. Director Avi Wisblagy. (Shekel) / דוקאביב 2025. מאה שנה להורה מסע בעקבות ריקודי העם כמשל לישראליות, מהחלום לברוא תרבות עברית חדשה ועד למאבק על זהות משותפת בחברה הישראלית של ימינו. במאי אבי וייסבלאי. (שח)

programme.title: Taboo Amos Gutman / טאבו עמוס גוטמן
programme.desc: The last photographed interview that the Busy Director Amos Gutman at his home in 1993, just before his death from AIDS, when he was only 38. (Shekel) / הראיון המצולם האחרון שקיים הבמאי פורץ הדרך עמוס גוטמן בביתו בשנת 1993, רגע לפני מותו ממחלת האיידס, כשהוא רק בן 38. הסרט מציג לראשונה קטעי ארכיון נדירים, לצד קטעים מסרטיו שטרם נראו וראיונות שטרם נשמעו. (שח)

programme.title: TMZ presents Hollywood Ozmic / TMZ מציג שיגעון האוזמפיק בהוליווד
programme.desc: A look at the Scini Shutts -known shots that became a hot trend, especially in Hollywood. But is a dark side to these drugs, precisely in a city that is famous for its glamor and stars? (Shekel) / מבט על הזריקות המכונות סקיני שוטס שהפכו לטרנד לוהט, במיוחד בהוליווד. אבל האם מסתתר צד אפל לתרופות האלו, דווקא בעיר שמפורסמת בזוהר ובאבק הכוכבים שלה? (שח)

programme.desc: Follow our fun show, discover interesting information you have not known before and enjoy the popular songs of new and old performers! / Pratite našu zabavnu emisiju, otkrijte zanimljive informacije koje ranije niste znali i uživajte u popularnim pjesmama novih i starih izvođača!

programme.title: Concert / Koncert
programme.desc: Enjoy with a musical program that brings us recordings of various, musical concerts. / Uživajte uz muzički program koji nam donosi snimke raznih, muzičkih koncerata.

programme.title: The city I love / Grad koji volim
programme.desc: This show represents a lexicon of the most important personality of our time, recording a story about them and their deeds. They come from different spheres of society, and what connects them is the fact that they create a public life of Montenegro. / Ova emisija predstavlja leksikon najznačajnijih ličnosti našeg vremena, beležeći priču o njima i njihovim djelima. Oni dolaze iz različitih sfera društva, a ono što ih povezuje jeste činjenica da oni kreiraju javni život Crne Gore.

programme.title: Diary 2 / Dnevnik 2
programme.desc: Follow the Dnevnik 2, one of the central, information broadcasters of Montenegro and find out all the most important news. / Pratite Dnevnik 2, jednu od centralnih, informativnih emisija Radio Televizije Crne Gore i saznajte sve najvažnije vijesti.

programme.title: Great Nordic myths / Veliki nordijski mitovi
programme.desc: Producers of the praised documentary series Greek myths, in a new endeavor will try to extract the true meaning of Nordic stories based on the old texts available. The story that influenced some of the most popular blockbusters of today, from Tolkin's lord of the rings until George Martin's throne. / Producenti hvaljene dokumentarne serije Grčki mitovi, u novom poduhvatu pokušaće da izvuku pravo značenje nordijskih priča na osnovu dostupnih starih tekstova. Priča koje su uticale na neke od najpopularnijih blokbastera današnjice, od Tolkinovog Gospodara prstenova do Igre prijestola Džordža Martina.

programme.title: I play my game / Igram svoju igru
programme.desc: The series intended for our youngest population is conceived to popularize and propagate a healthy lifestyle through sports and proper nutrition. Episodes intended for children engaged in sports, irrelevant at which success level, will show the essential advantages that provide sports and proper nutrition. We are of the opinion that in Montenegro has many talented children who do not have adequate conditions for the development of their talent. The series would be a modest initiator to raise the current situation on a bar for one step higher level. We want to draw attention to the potential belonging to us, which is indisputable, the potential that deserves much more. / Serijal namijenjen našoj najmlađoj populaciji koncipiran je da popularizuje i propagira zdrav način života kroz sport i pravilnu ishranu. Epizode namijenjene djeci koje se bave sportom, nebitno na kom nivou uspjeha, prikazaće suštinske prednosti koje pružaju sport i pravilna ishrana. Mišljenja smo da u Crnoj Gori ima mnogo talentovane djece koja nemaju adekvatne uslove za razvoj njihovog talenta. Serijal bi bio skroman inicijator da se trenutna situacija podigne na bar za jednu stepenicu veći nivo. Želimo da skrenemo pažnju na potencijal koji pripada samo nama, koji je neosporan, potencijal koji zaslužuje mnogo više.

programme.title: Football - 1. CFL: Other Round: Jedinstvo - Decic / Fudbal - 1. CFL: Drugo kolo: Jedinstvo - Dečić
programme.desc: The Montenegrin football league was founded in 2004. years but the first season was played in 2006/2007. after the independence of the state. 12 Clubs in a three-round system of the competition struggled for the title of the champion, which finally won Zeta from Golubovac, which was the only title of the Champions of Montenegro. Today's number of clubs has been reduced to 10 and plays 30 cars. / Crnogorska fudbalska liga osnovana je 2004. godine ali prva sezona odigrana je u sezoni 2006./2007. nakon osamostaljenja države. 12 klubova se u trokružnom sistemu takmičenja borilo za titulu prvaka koji je na kraju osvojila Zeta iz Golubovaca, kojoj je to ostala jedina titula prvaka Crne Gore. Današnji broj klubova smanjen je na 10 te se igra 30 kola.

programme.title: Mothers champions / Majke šampioni
programme.desc: In the six semi-municipal episodes, the interlocutors were mothers of large, trophy athletes who, everyone in their own way, marked the history of sports of these areas. Through what difficulties and waivers are the parents face when it is necessary to see the talent of your children? What's the moment, when you see in which direction they move their lives? How long does it take to make dreams come true, and how much to never come to these achievements? Unfortunately, during the series for TV Arena, the sport will also talk to the mother who was awarded the largest world tragedy, the loss of the child. About the deaths of their sons, the strengths were forces to talk mothers Dražen Petrović and Haris Brkić. Lifebers, laughter and tears, strong emotions would describe the six episodes of the series in which their lives and parenting represented Mothers of Novak Djokovic, Jelena Brooks, Luka Jovića, as well as mothers of the tragicly killed Drazen Petrovic and Haris Brkić. / U šest polusatnih epizoda sagovornice su bile majke velikih, trofejnih sportista koji su, svako na svoj način, obeležili istoriju sporta ovih prostora. Kroz kakve teškoće i odricanja se suočavaju roditelji kada je neophodno ispratiti talenat svoje dece? Koji je to trenutak, kada vidite u kom pravcu kreću njihovi životi? Koliko je potrebno da se snovi ostvare, a koliko da do tih ostvarenja nikada ni ne dođe? Nažalost, tokom serijala za TV Arena sport govoriće i majke koje je zadesila najveća ovozemaljska tragedija, gubitak deteta. O pogibijama svojih sinova smogle su snage da pričaju majke Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića. Životni ringišpil, smeh i suze, snažne emocije… tako bi u najkraćem opisali šest epizoda serijala u kojima su svoje živote i roditeljstvo predstavile majke Novaka Đokovića, Ivane Španović, Jelene Bruks, Luke Jovića kao i majke tragično nastradalih Dražena Petrovića i Harisa Brkića.

programme.desc: Serbia has its first basketball league as the highest rank of professional basketball in that country. The League itself was founded in 2006. and as such as 14 teams. programme.title: Fudbal - Liga Evrope: Roma - Porto / Fudbal - Liga Evrope: Roma - Porto
programme.desc: The second most prestigious club football competition in Europe is officially under the auspices of the European Football Federation of UEFE since 1971. years. The unofficial predecessor of this competition was a cup of fair cities that played since 1955. until 1971. years. From that season, the competition is officially called the UEFA Cup and is under that name until 2009. when it was renamed to the UEFA Europa League. Over the years, the competition format itself changed several times, and from the 2004/2005 season. A group phase was introduced after which the elimination follow. The trophy itself for the winner of this competition was designed in 1972. for the UEFA Cup final by the Italian artist Bertoni and each year is awarded to the winner who keeps him a year. / Drugo najprestižnije klupsko fudbalsko takmičenje u Evropi je službeno pod okriljem Evropske fudbalske federacije UEFE od 1971. godine. Neslužbeni prethodnik ovog takmičenja je bio Kup velesajamskih gradova koji se igrao od 1955. do 1971. godine. Od te sezone takmičenje se službeno zove Kup Uefa i pod tim nazivom je sve do 2009. kada je preimenovano u Uefa Ligu Evrope. Tokom godina se sam format takmičenja nekoliko puta menjao, a od sezone 2004./2005. uvedena je grupna faza nakon koje slede eliminacije. Sam trofej za pobednika ovog takmičenja dizajniran je 1972. za finale Kupa Uefa od strane italijanskog umetnika Bertonija i svake godine se dodeljuje pobedniku koji ga čuva godinu dana.

Sami klub je rasformiran 2009. godine iako imaju čak 13 titula prvaka Evrope. Naziv lige je od 1959. do 2000. godine bio Evropski Kup Prvaka nakon čega je sledila izmena u današnji naziv. Francuski klub Pariz Volej je bio prvi prvak pod novim nazivom takmičenja 2001. godine.

programme.title: Football: Spanish League - Top Goals / Fudbal: Španska liga - Top Goals
programme.desc: We bring you an overview of the most beautiful goals of La League, the competition founded back in 1929. years. Enjoy football magic and amazing moves of some of the best players of the world! / Donosimo vam pregled najlepših golova La lige, takmičenja koje je osnovano davne 1929. godine. Uživajte u fudbalskoj magiji i neverovatnim potezima nekih od najboljih igrača sveta!

programme.title: Football: Wwin League BiH: Worker - Posusje / Fudbal: WWIN Liga BIH: Radnik - Posušje
programme.desc: Founded in 2000. The Premier League of Bosnia and Herzegovina is the highest ranking of the football competition in BiH. The entrance of the cubes from the Republika Srpska two years later received a format with 16 clubs in the two-circular competition system. Today, 12 teams competed in the league, which has been divided into league after the 22-year-in-law and the league for survival. The first historical champion of BiH was a leotar from Trebinje. The club with the most conquered championship titles is Zrinjski from Mostar. The largest European success is the placement of the railway worker in the UEFA Cup semifinals in 1984. Years. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang fudbalskog takmičenja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dve godine kasnije liga dobija format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu takmičenja. Danas se u ligi takmiči 12 ekipa koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za opstanak. Prvi istorijski prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub sa najviše osvojenih titula prvaka je Zrinjski iz Mostara. Najveći evropski uspeh je plasman Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine.

programme.title: Football (M): Celje - Mura, first league Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Celje - Mura, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Celje people grind everything in front of them, the visit of the Muras should not be able to give them too much of a stock, but maybe knowing the fatigue due to European appearances. By 1990, the Slovenian Republican League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the then country. After establishing independence, only two clubs have never dropped out of the highest rank of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league is made up of ten teams, each playing four matches - two at home and two away, the last team on the rankings falls out, and the penultimate in qualifying is fighting for existence. / Celjani meljejo vse pred seboj, obisk Murašev jim ne bi smel predstavljati prevelikega zalogaja, a morda se zna poznati utrujenost zaradi evropskih nastopov.Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

Dva izjemna obveščevalna častnika, Montagu in Cholmondeley dobita nalogo, da se domislita in izvedeta najbolj neverjetno prevaro v vojni. programme.desc: R: Zemič Barbara ... Laibach band presents himself with a special project Volkswagner. It is a sonic suite based on Wagner's motifs and themes (Tannhauser, Siegfried idyll and hedgehog Valkir). The soloists are renowned jazz musicians Dejan Lapajna (guitar), Marko Črnčec (piano), Janez Gabrič (drums) and Horst-Michael Schaffer (trumpet). The recording of the concert was made in 2009 in Ljubljana, and the director was Barbara Zemljič. / R: Zemljič Barbara... Zasedba Laibach se predstavlja s posebnim projektom Volkswagner. programme.title: Video night / Videonoč
We predict / Napovedujemo
Witnesses: Martin Rojko, 2. Del, Mon. / Pričevalci: Martin Rojko, 2. del, pon.
programme.desc: He gives his extraordinary life story, which he also summarized in a book entitled: Everything Mines Once, with exceptional expansion, knowledge and kindness. Martin Rojko is an extremely practical and resourceful man with extraordinary logical thinking. He was one of the first owners of a disco magnetophone, with which he reclaimed music from the radio, recorded events at home and elsewhere. He also invented a special writer with sliding weights for drawing isochips, and this was a technology that created almost all the cards of Slovenia and the then Yugoslavia. As a trained topograph, he had an extensive phonotel of tapes, which he converted even into a digital record during digitization. He always liked to photograph, had his own darkness and developed his films himself. / Svojo izjemno življenjsko zgodbo, ki jo je tudi strnil v knjigi z naslovom: Vse mine enkrat, podaja z izjemno širilno, znanjem in prijaznostjo. Martin Rojko je izredno praktičen in iznajdljiv človek z izrednim logičnim razmišljanjem. Bil je eden prvih lastnikov kolutnega magnetofona, s pomočjo katerega je presnemaval glasbo z radia, snemal dogodke doma in drugje. Izumil je tudi posebno pisalo z drsno utežjo za risanje izohips in to je bila tehnologija, s katero so nastale skoraj vse karte Slovenije in takratne Jugoslavije. Kot izšolani topograf je imel obsežno fonoteko trakov, ki jo je v obdobju digitalizacije pretvoril celo v digitalni zapis. Vedno je rad tudi fotografiral, imel je svojo temnico in filme razvijal sam.

Space between us, Slovenian Youth Film, Mon. / Vesolje med nami, slovenski mladinski film, pon.
programme.sub-title: Vesolje med nami je mladinska drama o odraščanju, postavljena v mestece Kostanjevica na Krki. Zgodba govori o 14-letnemu Kanadčanu Tobiju, ki z mamo Kristino za poletne počitnice pripotuje na obisk v Slovenijo, k babici Gizeli. Kristine že več let ni bi
programme.desc: I: Barisic Ivo (Herman), Chilima Buddha Kolja (Tobi), Dorrer Manca (Kristina), Mihelič Irena (Gizela); R: JAGRIC PIRC Rahela ... The universe between us is a youth drama about growing up, set in the town of Kostanjevica na Krki. The story is about 14-year-old Canadian Tobi, who with his mother Kristina for a summer vacation to visit Slovenia, to Grandma Gizela. Kristina has not been in her hometown for many years, but now she has come suddenly and with a lot of news of the exhibition she is expected to prepare at the local gallery. Tobi is not impressed with the idea that he will spend his holidays in a foreign country, without friends and father. Bad will is escalating when he first encounters racial prejudices of local children. The only bright spot is Tjaša, who is very attracted to him with his adventure nature. Their socializing leads him to an unusual encounter with a blinded astronomer Herman, who is like a "village outcast". Herman opens the door to a forgotten observatory to Tobi, where, with the help of his rich knowledge of astronomy, he gives him life lessons that originate in space and relate to life on Earth. The star observatory also becomes a shelter to Tobi, where he escapes with a new realization that parents have problems in marriage and that the previously planned Kristina exhibition was actually an excuse to escape from Canada. On the web of intense emotions and dynamic events, both Tobi and Kristina have to face pressing relationships, repressed fears and a local society that looks at them as if they were from another planet ....... / I: Barišič Ivo (Herman), Chilima Budišin Kolja (Tobi), Dorrer Manca (Kristina), Mihelič Irena (Gizela); R: Jagrič Pirc Rahela... Vesolje med nami je mladinska drama o odraščanju, postavljena v mestece Kostanjevica na Krki. Zgodba govori o 14-letnemu Kanadčanu Tobiju, ki z mamo Kristino za poletne počitnice pripotuje na obisk v Slovenijo, k babici Gizeli. Kristine že več let ni bilo v domače kraje, sedaj pa je prišla nenadoma in z veliko novico o razstavi, ki naj bi jo pripravila v lokalni galeriji. Tobi ni navdušen nad idejo, da bo počitnice preživel v tuji deželi, brez prijateljev in očeta. Slaba volja se stopnjuje, ko se prvič sreča z rasnimi predsodki lokalnih otrok. Edino svetlo točko mu predstavlja Tjaša, ki ga s svojo pustolovsko naravo zelo privlači. Njuno druženje ga pripelje do nenavadnega srečanja z oslepelim astronomom Hermanom, ki je prav tako kot Tobi “vaški izobčenec”. Herman odpre Tobiju vrata pozabljenega observatorija, kjer mu s pomočjo svojega bogatega znanja o astronomiji podeli življenjske nauke, ki izvirajo v vesolju in se nanašajo na življenje na Zemlji. Zvezdni observatorij pa postane Tobiju tudi zatočišče, kamor beži ob novem spoznanju, da imata starša v zakonu težave in da je bila predhodno planirana Kristinina razstava pravzaprav izgovor za pobeg iz Kanade. V spletu intenzivnih čustev in dinamičnih dogodkov se morata tako Tobi, kot Kristina soočiti s perečimi odnosi, potlačenimi strahovi ter lokalno družbo, ki nanju gleda, kot da sta z drugega planeta.......

programme.title: Doberdob - Roman rebel, documentary, Mon. / Doberdob - roman upornika, dokumentarni film, pon.
programme.sub-title: R: Turk Martin... Leta 1930 Cankarjeva založba napove izid vojnega romana Doberdob pisatelja Prežihovega Voranca.
programme.desc: The novel was supposed to list the tragic stories of soldiers who fought on the Doberdob Plateau in World War I, where the twenty -two -year -old writer also fought. In fact, the novel only came out in 1940, and the writer writes it three times in ten years since the announcement of the release, as the manuscript repeatedly disappears in unusual circumstances - also because he was produced in the period that Prežihov Voranc mostly survived in illegal. Voranc was not only a writer, but also one of the first communists in Slovenia, a comintern agent, a traveler and a polyglot, and personally a very modest man with values who, over time, were no longer in the spirit of all hard party ideology. Doberdob-The rebel's novel is a feature-acting film about the thorny path of the only Slovenian autobiographical novel on World War I and a portrait of his chubby author, writer and political activist Lovro Kuhar-Prežihov Voranc. / Roman naj bi popisal tragične zgodbe vojakov, ki so se v prvi svetovni vojni borili na Doberdobski planoti, kjer se je bojeval tudi takrat dvaindvajsetletni pisatelj. Roman v resnici izide šele leta 1940, pisatelj pa ga v desetih letih od napovedi izida napiše kar trikrat, saj rokopis vedno znova izgine v nenavadnih okoliščinah – tudi zato, ker je nastajal v obdobju, ki ga je Prežihov Voranc kot politični aktivist večinoma preživel v ilegali. Voranc namreč ni bil le pisatelj, pač pa tudi eden prvih komunistov na Slovenskem, agent Kominterne, popotnik in poliglot, osebno pa zelo skromen mož z vrednotami, ki sčasoma niso bile več v duhu vse trše partijske ideologije. Doberdob – roman upornika je igrano-dokumentarni film o trnovi poti edinega slovenskega avtobiografskega romana na temo prve svetovne vojne in portret njegovega klenega avtorja, pisatelja in političnega aktivista Lovra Kuharja – Prežihovega Voranca.

programme.title: Through my eyes: epilogue, documentary series, Mon. / Skozi moje oči: Epilog, dokumentarna serija, pon.
programme.sub-title: To je serija o opazovalcu in Parizu v dvajsetih letih 20. stoletja, ko je mesto postalo središče sodobne umetnosti.
programme.desc: At that time, Paris was a gathering place for newcomers who came from Eastern Europe to the capital of art, hoped for artistic fame and in his bohemianity looking for his space, mostly day after day and from his hands in his mouth ... Among them was a talented, already established painter Veno Pilon. Atelier and modest residence at Montparnasse 75, which Frederic Beigbeder wrote: "Montparnasse is a quarter where sex, literature and death reign." Here he met Henry Miller, Max Ernst, Ossip Zadkin, Giorgia De Chirica, Roland Oudo. He wrote, "Because my faith in my own work was undermined, I was no longer drawn to painting, painting was resisted. I resorted to Paris to get lost in the crowd and forget myself ... So I avoided exhibitions. ”After arriving in Paris, he abandoned painting, and was taken over by photography. Pilon in Paris failed to break through among the most famous photographers, which was to blame for excessive modesty and lack of self -esteem. For these two reasons, Pilon also finished his painting creation too soon. With Andre Kertessz, Henri Cartier-Bresson and Brassai, he was a beginner of reportage photography. Later, on his side of Mana Ray, Christian Schad, Laszla Moholy-Nagya sought his experimental expression and his place within the new avant-garde aesthetics. When he married, he moved away from bohemian life and abandoned socializing with representatives of avant-garde Montparnac montmisions. The photography, however, became his source of earnings, with which he spent his family. In 1968 he returned home, and he actually photographed until the last day. His latest slides have only been discovered recently. Jean Cocteau said in one of his most famous quotes: "In Paris, everyone would like to be actors, no one wants to be a spectator." It was just the Cocteau, who, at his first Paris exhibition at the Carrefour Gallery in 1934, attached his long poet to the mask in 1934. " Ironically, however, Cocteau's quote is not true for Pilon. Pilon was first an observer of life, and only then a "performer" and everything else… Photography was Pilon's hidden passion, a quiet love that had been devoted to all his life. / Pariz je bil takrat zbirališče prišlekov, ki so iz vzhodne Evrope prihajali v prestolnico umetnosti, upali na umetniško slavo in v njegovi boemskosti iskali svoj prostor, večinoma iz dneva v dan in iz rok v usta ...Med njimi je bil tudi nadarjen, doma že uveljavljen slikar Veno Pilon. Atelje in skromno prebivališče je imel na bulvarju Montparnasse 75, o katerem je Frederic Beigbeder zapisal: »Montparnasse je četrt, kjer kraljujejo seks, literatura in smrt.« Tu je srečeval Henryja Millerja, Maxa Ernsta, Ossipa Zadkina, Giorgia De Chirica, Rolanda Oudoja ... Čez dve leti, ko je postal eden izmed njih, pa je zapisal: »Ker se mi je vera v lastno delo omajala, me k slikanju ni več vleklo, slikanje se mi je upiralo. Zatekel sem se v Pariz, da se v množici izgubim in pozabim nase ... Zato sem se tudi izogibal razstav.« Po prihodu v Pariz je opustil slikanje, prevzela ga je fotografija. Pilonu v Parizu ni uspel preboj med najbolj znane fotografe, za kar sta bila kriva pretirana skromnost in pomanjkanje samozavesti. Iz teh dveh razlogov je Pilon tudi veliko prezgodaj končal svoje slikarsko ustvarjanje.S fotografiranjem del parnasovcev, portreti najpomembnejših umetnikov francoske umetniške šole ter posnetki Pariza je bil Pilon izjemno pomemben za razvoj fotografske umetnosti. Ob Andreu Kerteszu, Henriju Cartier-Bressonu in Brassaiu je bil začetnik reportažne fotografije. Pozneje pa je ob boku Mana Raya, Christiana Schada, Laszla Moholy-Nagya iskal svoj eksperimentalen izraz in svoje mesto znotraj novih avantgardnih estetik.Potem ko se je poročil, se je oddaljil od boemskega življenja in opustil druženje s predstavniki avantgardnih montparnaških omizij. Je pa fotografiranje postalo njegov vir zaslužka, s katerim je preživljal družino. Leta 1968 se je vrnil v domovino, fotografiral pa je pravzaprav do zadnjega dne. Njegovi zadnji diapozitivi so bili odkriti šele pred kratkim. Jean Cocteau je v enem od svojih najbolj znanih citatov rekel takole: »V Parizu bi bili vsi radi igralci, nihče noče biti samo gledalec.« To je bil prav tisti Cocteau, ki je Pilonu na njegovi prvi pariški razstavi v galeriji Carrefour leta 1934 na fotografijo Maske pritrdil svojo dolgo pesnitev ter mu ob njej napisa spoštljivo posvetilo: »To je bilo moje največje priznanje iz te dobe.« Ironično pa Cocteaujev citat ravno za Pilona ne drži. Pilon je bil namreč najprej opazovalec življenja in šele nato »nastopač« in vse drugo … Fotografija je bila Pilonova skrita strast, tiha ljubezen, ki ji je bil predan vse svoje življenje.Scenarij in režija Igor Vrtačnik.

programme.desc: The show, alternately run by Bernarda Žarn, Špela Močnik Paradiž and Andrej Hofer, will have a pleasant socializing with melodies, memories and a relaxed chat all summer long on Saturdays. programme.sub-title: A Brief History Of The Future; Kratka zgodovina prihodnosti je edinstvena dokumentarna serija o različicah naše prihodnosti in o tem, kako si jih lahko zamislimo. Vodi jo priznani futurist Ari Wallach, ki nas popelje na potovanje po svetu, na katerem od
programme.desc: Part 5: Can we create a future that will serve the needs of everyone? As we develop, changes in us can also affect other, wider community and society. This can become a catalyst of changes in the entire system. programme.title: The convicts / Die Verurteilten
programme.desc: In 1946 Andy Dufresne was admitted to Maine's state prison of Maine. Although the young vice director of a bank always asserted his innocence, he was sentenced to twice for lifetime for double murder on his wife and her lover. While the process was talked about by Andy's education, origin and good reputation - other rules apply in jail. Everyone is "innocent", sit for lifetely and campaign for survival. Not only the co -breeds, but also a prison director Norton, who already proves to be as Bible -believable as it is brutally when it comes to greeting. His introverted and distinguished manner is excited by the co -breeds. He is scanned, pronounced, raped. But Andy doesn't let himself get down. He is silent where others scream, stays calm where others romp. In doing so, he conquered the respect and friendship of Red, who has become the “head of the village” of Shawshank in the long years of his detention and runs a lucrative smuggling ring. After Andy has been brutally crowded again, he ends up in the hospital room and is then transferred to the library to work. There he runs his new job with meticulousness and dedication and gradually gives Shawshak the greatest prison library in the USA. Director Norton also takes advantage of Andy's services and operates illegal jobs with his help. After many years, one appears among the newcomers who could prove Andy innocence. "The Shawshank Redemption" is the first movie of television director and screenwriter Frank Darabont. Stephen King's repayment “Rita Hayworth and the Shawshank Redemption”, which is included in the “Different Seasons” anthology, served as a template for this melodrama about the normal horror of the junction. In it, King describes the problems of long-term prisoners: aggression, lack of dealing with the opposite sex, sexual need, life in a closed society functioning according to hard rules, fear of freedom. "The Shawshank Redemption" was shot in an empty, built in 1896 and now demolished prison complex in Mansfield, Ohio. / 1946 wird Andy Dufresne in Shawshank, dem Staatsgefangnis von Maine, eingeliefert. Obwohl der junge Vize-Direktor einer Bank stets seine Unschuld beteuerte, wurde er wegen Doppelmordes an seiner Gattin und deren Liebhaber zu zweimal lebenslanglich verurteilt. Hatte man wahrend des Prozesses noch von Andys Bildung, Herkunft und gutem Leumund geredet - im Knast gelten andere Regeln. Da sind alle «unschuldig», sitzen lebenslanglich und kampfen knallhart ums Überleben. Nicht nur die Mitinsassen, sondern auch Gefangnisdirektor Norton , der sich schon bei der Begrussung als ebenso bibelglaubig wie brutal erweist.Andy wird zur Arbeit in der Wascherei abkommandiert. Seine introvertierte und distinguierte Art reizt die Mitinsassen. Er wird gehanselt, verprugelt, vergewaltigt. Doch Andy lasst sich nicht unterkriegen. Er schweigt, wo andere schreien, bleibt ruhig, wo andere toben. Damit erobert er sich die Achtung und Freundschaft von Red , der in den langen Jahren seiner Haft zum «Dorfoberhaupt» von Shawshank geworden ist und einen lukrativen Schmuggelring betreibt. Nachdem Andy wieder mal besonders brutal drangenommen worden ist, landet er im Krankenzimmer und wird daraufhin zur Arbeit in die Bibliothek versetzt. Dort betreibt er seinen neuen Job mit Akribie und Hingabe und verschafft Shawshank allmahlich die grosste Gefangnisbibliothek der USA.Nebenbei berat er Mitinsassen und Warter in Finanz- und Steuerfragen und wird ihnen zum unentbehrlichen Kumpel. Auch Direktor Norton nimmt Andys Dienste in Anspruch und betreibt mit seiner Hilfe illegale Geschafte. Nach langen Jahren taucht unter den Neuankommlingen einer auf, der Andys Unschuld beweisen konnte.«The Shawshank Redemption» ist der erste Kinofilm von Fernsehregisseur und Drehbuchautor Frank Darabont. Als Vorlage fur dieses Melodrama uber den ganz normalen Horror des Knastalltags diente Stephen Kings Erzahlung «Rita Hayworth and the Shawshank Redemption», die im Sammelband «Different Seasons» enthalten ist. King schildert darin die Probleme von Langzeit-Gefangenen: Aggressionen, fehlender Umgang mit dem anderen Geschlecht, sexuelle Not, das Leben in einer nach harten Regeln funktionierenden, geschlossenen Gesellschaft, die Angst vor der Freiheit. «The Shawshank Redemption» wurde in einem leerstehenden, 1896 erbauten und inzwischen abgerissenen Gefangniskomplex in Mansfield, Ohio, gedreht.Darabonts Film, der von dem starken Spiel seiner drei Hauptdarsteller Tim Robbins, Morgan Freeman und Bob Gunton und der atmospharisch dichten Musik Thomas Newmans lebt, wurde fur sieben Oscars nominiert.

programme.title: Wim Wenders: The eternal searcher / Wim Wenders: Der ewig Suchende
programme.desc: Wim Wenders has been making a new film every one to two years since the mid-1960s. It is noteworthy of how his work is constantly changing. He shoots roadmovies such as "Paris, Texas", experimental film collages such as "The Heaven Uber Berlin" or documentary films such as "Tokyo-GA". Wim Wender's origin is not exactly typical of someone who is one of the greatest living German film directors today. The father was a doctor, the mother housewife, his childhood in the Ruhr area rather traditionally. In the mid-1960s, Wenders moved to Paris to study painting there. He spends his free hours in the Cinemathèque Française to watch films there. He falls in love with the medium of film. In the end, Wenders saw a thousand films in Paris in his year. / Seit Mitte der 60er-Jahre dreht Wim Wenders alle ein bis zwei Jahre einen neuen Film. Bemerkenswert daran ist, wie sich sein Werk standig verandert. Er dreht Roadmovies wie «Paris, Texas», experimentelle Filmcollagen wie «Der Himmel uber Berlin» oder Dokumentarfilme wie «Tokyo-Ga». Dabei ist Wim Wenders Herkunft nicht gerade typisch fur jemanden, der heute einer der grossten lebenden deutschen Filmregisseure ist. Der Vater war Arzt, die Mutter Hausfrau, seine Kindheit im Ruhrgebiet eher traditionell. Mitte der 60er-Jahre wechselt Wenders nach Paris, um dort Malerei zu studieren. Seine freien Stunden verbringt er in der Cinemathèque française, um dort Filme zu schauen. Er verliebt sich in das Medium Film. Am Ende hat Wenders in seinem Jahr in Paris an die tausend Filme gesehen.

programme.title: Using Oerlike / Usfahrt Oerlike
programme.desc: Hans is 80. He experienced a lot, traveled to the world, a family. A few years ago, his beloved Ms. Martha died. Now he has to let his dog fall asleep. He is sad and lonely. He is also getting worse and worse in terms of health. Everyday life is difficult to master. After not getting out of bed one morning because of a misfortune, he is instructed by his doctor to the retirement home for his own security. This is a horror for him, although life there could actually be very pleasant. Nurse Mary Kiefer around him with great commitment, and the neat Emilie tries to integrate him into home life. But Hans blocks everything unfriendly. The great fear of a long death path is plagued by him. That is why he asks his old musician friend Willi to get him a death agent, but this is emotionally overwhelmed by this wish. He asks Beat, Hans's son, to get his father. But he broke off contact. After a stroke of brain, from which he recovered well, Hans realizes that he has to face the uneducated things of his life. It is the only feature film in which the two large entertainment scene can be seen together. / Hans ist 80. Er hat viel erlebt, die Welt bereist, eine Familie gegrundet. Vor ein paar Jahren ist seine geliebte Frau Martha gestorben. Nun muss er seinen Hund altershalber einschlafern lassen. Er ist traurig und einsam. Auch gesundheitlich geht es ihm immer schlechter. Der Alltag lasst sich nur noch schwer meistern. Nachdem er eines Morgens wegen eines Missgeschicks nicht mehr aus dem Bett kommt, wird er von seinem Arzt zur eigenen Sicherheit ins Altersheim eingewiesen.Dies ist ihm ein Graus, obwohl das Leben dort eigentlich ganz angenehm sein konnte. Pflegerin Mary kummert sich mit grossem Engagement um ihn, und die adrette Emilie versucht, ihn ins Heimleben zu integrieren. Doch Hans blockt alles unfreundlich ab. Ihn plagt die grosse Angst vor einem langen Sterbensweg. Darum bittet er seinen alten Musikerfreund Willi, ihm ein Sterbemittel zu besorgen.Doch Willi sieht sich von diesem Wunsch emotional uberfordert. Er bittet Beat, den Sohn von Hans, sich um seinen Vater zu kummern. Doch dieser hat den Kontakt abgebrochen. Nach einem Hirnschlag, von dem er sich gut erholt, realisiert Hans, dass er sich den ungelosten Dingen seines Lebens stellen muss.Der Spielfilm «Usfahrt Oerlike» mit den Hauptdarstellern Jorg Schneider und Mathias Gnadinger wurde an den Solothurner Filmtagen 2015 mit dem Publikumspreis ausgezeichnet. Es ist der einzige Spielfilm, in dem die beiden Grossen der Schweizer Unterhaltungsszene zusammen zu sehen sind.

programme.title: Wild - Jager and Collector / Wild - Jager and Sammler
programme.desc: Hunting is one of the oldest cultural techniques in the world. During the hunting season, the filmmaker Mario Theus accompanies a hunter, a Wildhuterin and a former Wilderer who exchanged his rifle for the film camera. They all share very original motivations: hunting fever, hunting instinct and the longing for life as a hunter and collector. They have a great knowledge of nature, over mountain and valley and over the residence locations of the wild animals. To do this, you can also master the necessary practical seams such as stalking, waiting, seeing, smelling, smelling and hearing the smallest details. It creates a deep connection towards nature across generations. The filmmaker was six years old when he was allowed to accompany his father for the first time on the hunt. The Wildhutern Pirmina Caminada regularly takes her daughter Angela into the mountains and passes on the knowledge of the ancestors of landscape and animals. As a mountain farmer and hunter, Andreas Kaslin and his family are able to take the become and offenses of nature in mind. The film also shows how children experience hunting up close and are confronted with the great philosophical questions of life and dying. The film calls for thinking about dealing with nature and contradiction to meat consumption. / Die Jagd ist eine der altesten Kulturtechniken der Welt. Wahrend der Jagdsaison begleitet der Filmemacher Mario Theus einen Jager, eine Wildhuterin und einen ehemaligen Wilderer, der sein Gewehr gegen die Filmkamera eingetauscht hat. Alle teilen sie sehr ursprungliche Motivationen: das Jagdfieber, den Jagdinstinkt und die Sehnsucht nach dem Leben als Jager und Sammler. Sie besitzen ein grosses Wissen uber die Natur, uber Berg und Tal und uber die Aufenhaltsorte der Wildtiere. Dazu beherrschen sie auch die notigen praktischen Fahigkeiten wie Pirschen, Warten, Sehen, Riechen und Horen kleinster Details.Die Jagd ist nicht bloss eine Urform der Nahrungsbeschaffung. Sie schafft eine tiefe Verbundenheit zur Natur uber Generationen hinweg. Der Filmemacher war sechs Jahre alt, als er seinen Vater zum ersten Mal auf der Jagd begleiten durfte. Die Wildhutern Pirmina Caminada nimmt ihre Tochter Angela regelmassig mit in die Berge und gibt ihr das Wissen der Vorfahren uber Landschaft und Tiere weiter. Als Bergbauer und Jager werden Andreas Kaslin und seiner Familie das Werden und Vergehen der Natur standig vor Augen gefuhrt. So zeigt der Film auch wie Kinder die Jagd hautnah miterleben und dabei ganz selbstverstandlich mit den grossen philosophischen Fragen von Leben und Sterben konfrontiert werden. Der Film fordert zum Nachdenken uber den Umgang mit der Natur und die Widerspruche des Fleischkonsums auf.

programme.title: The convicts / Die Verurteilten
programme.desc: In 1946 Andy Dufresne was admitted to Maine's state prison of Maine. Although the young vice director of a bank always asserted his innocence, he was sentenced to twice for lifetime for double murder on his wife and her lover. While the process was talked about by Andy's education, origin and good reputation - other rules apply in jail. Everyone is "innocent", sit for lifetely and campaign for survival. Not only the co -breeds, but also a prison director Norton, who already proves to be as Bible -believable as it is brutally when it comes to greeting. His introverted and distinguished manner is excited by the co -breeds. He is scanned, pronounced, raped. But Andy doesn't let himself get down. He is silent where others scream, stays calm where others romp. In doing so, he conquered the respect and friendship of Red, who has become the “head of the village” of Shawshank in the long years of his detention and runs a lucrative smuggling ring. After Andy has been brutally crowded again, he ends up in the hospital room and is then transferred to the library to work. There he runs his new job with meticulousness and dedication and gradually gives Shawshak the greatest prison library in the USA. Director Norton also takes advantage of Andy's services and operates illegal jobs with his help. After many years, one appears among the newcomers who could prove Andy innocence. "The Shawshank Redemption" is the first movie of television director and screenwriter Frank Darabont. Stephen King's repayment “Rita Hayworth and the Shawshank Redemption”, which is included in the “Different Seasons” anthology, served as a template for this melodrama about the normal horror of the junction. In it, King describes the problems of long-term prisoners: aggression, lack of dealing with the opposite sex, sexual need, life in a closed society functioning according to hard rules, fear of freedom. "The Shawshank Redemption" was shot in an empty, built in 1896 and now demolished prison complex in Mansfield, Ohio. / 1946 wird Andy Dufresne in Shawshank, dem Staatsgefangnis von Maine, eingeliefert. Obwohl der junge Vize-Direktor einer Bank stets seine Unschuld beteuerte, wurde er wegen Doppelmordes an seiner Gattin und deren Liebhaber zu zweimal lebenslanglich verurteilt. Hatte man wahrend des Prozesses noch von Andys Bildung, Herkunft und gutem Leumund geredet - im Knast gelten andere Regeln. Da sind alle «unschuldig», sitzen lebenslanglich und kampfen knallhart ums Überleben. Nicht nur die Mitinsassen, sondern auch Gefangnisdirektor Norton , der sich schon bei der Begrussung als ebenso bibelglaubig wie brutal erweist.Andy wird zur Arbeit in der Wascherei abkommandiert. Seine introvertierte und distinguierte Art reizt die Mitinsassen. Er wird gehanselt, verprugelt, vergewaltigt. Doch Andy lasst sich nicht unterkriegen. Er schweigt, wo andere schreien, bleibt ruhig, wo andere toben. Damit erobert er sich die Achtung und Freundschaft von Red , der in den langen Jahren seiner Haft zum «Dorfoberhaupt» von Shawshank geworden ist und einen lukrativen Schmuggelring betreibt. Nachdem Andy wieder mal besonders brutal drangenommen worden ist, landet er im Krankenzimmer und wird daraufhin zur Arbeit in die Bibliothek versetzt. Dort betreibt er seinen neuen Job mit Akribie und Hingabe und verschafft Shawshank allmahlich die grosste Gefangnisbibliothek der USA.Nebenbei berat er Mitinsassen und Warter in Finanz- und Steuerfragen und wird ihnen zum unentbehrlichen Kumpel. Auch Direktor Norton nimmt Andys Dienste in Anspruch und betreibt mit seiner Hilfe illegale Geschafte. Nach langen Jahren taucht unter den Neuankommlingen einer auf, der Andys Unschuld beweisen konnte.«The Shawshank Redemption» ist der erste Kinofilm von Fernsehregisseur und Drehbuchautor Frank Darabont. Als Vorlage fur dieses Melodrama uber den ganz normalen Horror des Knastalltags diente Stephen Kings Erzahlung «Rita Hayworth and the Shawshank Redemption», die im Sammelband «Different Seasons» enthalten ist. King schildert darin die Probleme von Langzeit-Gefangenen: Aggressionen, fehlender Umgang mit dem anderen Geschlecht, sexuelle Not, das Leben in einer nach harten Regeln funktionierenden, geschlossenen Gesellschaft, die Angst vor der Freiheit. «The Shawshank Redemption» wurde in einem leerstehenden, 1896 erbauten und inzwischen abgerissenen Gefangniskomplex in Mansfield, Ohio, gedreht.Darabonts Film, der von dem starken Spiel seiner drei Hauptdarsteller Tim Robbins, Morgan Freeman und Bob Gunton und der atmospharisch dichten Musik Thomas Newmans lebt, wurde fur sieben Oscars nominiert.

programme.title: Just be back / Einfach retour
programme.desc: An island like from the holiday catalog - and yet: no one far and wide. Welcome to Brac, Coratia, where Jan Fitze is suspended in the middle of the previous season. Sun, sea, and nothing. A plan is needed - or first of all a bath in the sea for the euphoric Jan. and then, like out of nowhere, "Angel" appears. Yes, really - that is what it means. The man not only saves Jan's day, but also lines to a feast and offers an apartment in Zagreb. But as is well known, there is a very deep, very cold case - in this case directly into a construction site at Zagreb. No success at the Autostop, Cracker instead of a gourmet cake - and at the end a cold night on a construction site. The rescue comes on rails: train journey to Ljubljana. And there the flash of inspiration: the Ski World Cup in Saalbach. Where, if not there, Jan was able to find patriotic celebrating Swiss who have him home? The new plan is daring. Absurd, actually. And the time runs. Without a smartphone, without backup, but with a painting box and a half -cooked escape plan, Jan tries the impossible: to come back to Zurich in time. Will he meet another miracle - or at least one car? And what does satirist Patti Basler have to do with it? The slopes are praised - and Jan gives everything. / Eine Insel wie aus dem Ferienkatalog - und trotzdem: kein Mensch weit und breit. Willkommen auf Brac, Koratien, wo Jan Fitze mitten in der Vorsaison ausgesetzt wird. Sonne, Meer, und nichts. Ein Plan muss her - oder zuerst einmal ein Bad im Meer fur den euphorischen Jan. Und dann, wie aus dem Nichts, erscheint «Angel». Ja, wirklich - so heisst er. Der Mann rettet nicht nur Jans Tag, sondern ladt ein zu einem Festschmaus und offeriert ein Appartement in Zagreb.Aber bekanntlich folgt auf jedes Hoch ein sehr tiefer, sehr kalter Fall - in diesem Fall direkt in eine Baustelle bei Zagreb. Kein Erfolg beim Autostop, Cracker statt Gourmetkuche - und am Schluss eine kalte Nacht auf einer Baustelle.Die Rettung kommt auf Schienen: Zugfahrt nach Ljubljana. Und dort der Geistesblitz: die Ski-WM in Saalbach. Wo, wenn nicht dort, konnte Jan patriotisch feiernde Schweizerinnen und Schweizer finden, die ihn heimchauffieren?Der neue Plan ist waghalsig. Absurd, eigentlich. Und die Zeit lauft. Ohne Smartphone, ohne Backup, aber mit Malkasten und einem halbgar gebackenen Fluchtplan versucht Jan das Unmogliche: rechtzeitig zuruck nach Zurich zu kommen. Wird ihm erneut ein Wunder - oder wenigstens ein Auto - begegnen? Und was hat die Satirikerin Patti Basler damit zu tun?Die Uhr tickt. Die Piste ist prapariert - und Jan gibt Alles.

programme.title: Ding Dong - The 10 most printed holiday homes / Ding Dong - Die 10 verrucktesten Ferienhauser
programme.sub-title: Mosaik-Villa und durchdesigntes Hohlenhaus in Vals
programme.desc: Jurg Duchilio - Duschi - is also creative in his job as a hairdresser. As a child, his mother apparently referred to him as a "spinner". However, his father already pointed out at the time: "Leave him, there are normal enough." Today the inherited house in Thun Be would still be still white, would not be "printed out" enough to design it according to his creative ideas. The Villa Vals in the Bundner village of the same name is a real bijou. The Hohlenhaus is designed. The “Ding Dong” crew can spend one night there and first explores the house alone. The owners only appear in the morning and tell what their very personal "touch" has. During Jan Fitze and Viola Tami enjoy the summer at the lake, they indulge in memories of home visits that have left holiday thoughts. Some of them are holiday homes, others simply invite you to dream and let your mind wander. This is how it shows the venue for longing in the high mountains, waters and in imaginative Marchen worlds. / Kreativ ist Jurg Duchilio - Duschi - auch in seinem Beruf als Coiffeur. Als Kind hat seine Mutter ihn offenbar als «Spinner» bezeichnet. Sein Vater gab jedoch schon damals zu bedenken: «Lass ihn, Normale gibt es genug.» Heute ware das geerbte Haus in Thun BE wahrscheinlich noch immer weiss, ware Duschi eben nicht «verruckt» genug, um es nach seinen kreativen Ideen zu gestalten.Die Villa Vals im gleichnamigen Bundner Dorf ist ein richtiges Bijou. Das Hohlenhaus ist durchdesignt. Die «Ding Dong»-Crew darf dort eine Nacht verbringen und erkundet das Haus zuerst allein. Die Besitzer tauchen erst am Morgen danach auf und erzahlen, was im Haus ihren ganz personlichen «touch» hat.Ferien-Feeling à la «Ding Dong». Wahrend Jan Fitze und Viola Tami den Sommer am See geniessen, schwelgen sie in Erinnerungen an Hausbesuche, die bei ihnen Feriengefuhle hinterlassen haben. Einige davon sind Ferienhauser, andere laden ganz einfach ein zum Traumen und die Seele baumeln zu lassen.Diese Ruckblick-Reise zeigt Sehnsuchtsorte in den hohen Bergen, an wunderschonen Gewassern und in fantasievollen Marchenwelten.

programme.title: Inga Lindstrom: The secret of the Nordquists / Inga Lindstrom: Das Geheimnis der Nordquists
programme.desc: The archaologist Emilia wants to prove that there were also wikers among Vikings. After a noise at the university, she decides to search on her own on her own. Alexander, the man's son, is also looking for traces: he plans to emigrate to Japan, but before that he wants to loose the council around his twin brother, who disappeared years ago. Emilia is blown to Alexander, but his brother Viktor also seems to be very interested in Emilia. Nevertheless, Emilia has no idea that the council around Alexander's disappeared twins and her own search were closely related. / Die Archaologin Emilia will beweisen, dass es unter Wikingern auch beruhmte Kriegerinnen gab. Nach einem Krach an der Uni beschliesst sie, auf eigene Faust nach Belegen zu suchen.Eine Spur fuhrt Emilia auf das Anwesen der Familie Nordquist. Dort kann sie sich als neue Gartnerin einschleichen. Auch Alexander , der Sohn des Gutsbesitzers, ist auf Spurensuche: Zwar plant er, nach Japan auszuwandern, vorher jedoch will er das Ratsel um seinen Zwillingsbruder losen, der vor Jahren verschwand. Emilia fuhlt sich zu Alexander hingezogen, doch dessen Bruder Viktor scheint sich ebenfalls sehr fur Emilia zu interessieren.Noch ahnt Emilia nicht, dass das Ratsel um Alexanders verschwundenen Zwilling und ihre eigene Suche eng zusammenhangen.

programme.title: The intern / Die Praktikantin
programme.desc: Nursing staff Natalie (Dorothee Muggler) takes the intern Lina under her wing on her first working day in the hospital. Now he has the chance: he can take over the role of a success manager who comes to the hospital for an examination. In 2011, the Swiss Film Award was nominated with two films: With the short film "Die Wäntin" and with the long feature film "Der Sandmann", who had previously won the audience award in Saarbrucken in Saarbrucken. For his extraordinary short feature film "The intern", he worked with the Aargau Hospital, which is interested in recruiting the short feature film young nursing staff. The somewhat different short confusion comedy was able to hire the two young talents Judith Koch and Aaron Hitz along with seasoned Swiss stars like Beat Schlatter and Dorothee Muggler. Alexandra Prusa, Michael Neuenschwander and Max Rudlinger also appear in supporting roles. / Pflegefachkraft Natalie (Dorothee Muggler) nimmt die Praktikantin Lina an ihrem erstem Arbeitstag im Spital unter ihre Fittiche. Spitalkoch Werner schmachtet seit langerem nach Natalie, ist aber uberzeugt, dass Pflegerinnen nur Augen fur Ärzte oder reiche Patienten haben. Nun bietet sich ihm die Chance: Er kann die Rolle eines Erfolgsmanagers ubernehmen, der zu einer Untersuchung ins Spital kommt. Doch ausgerechnet sein Kochassistent Marco, der sich als Arzt ausgibt, um die Praktikantin Lina zu beeindrucken, behandelt diesen falschen Patienten.Am Schweizer Filmpreis 2011 war Peter Luisi gleich mit zwei Filmen nominiert: Mit dem Kurzfilm «Die Praktikantin» und mit dem Langspielfilm «Der Sandmann», der zuvor schon am Max-Ophuls-Filmfestival in Saarbrucken den Publikumspreis gewonnen hatte. Fur seinen ausserst kurzweiligen Kurzspielfilm «Die Praktikantin» hat er mit der Spital Region Aargau zusammengearbeitet, das daran interessiert ist, mit dem Kurzspielfilm junges Pflegepersonal anzuwerben.Fur die etwas andere kurze Verwechslungskomodie konnte Luisi die beiden jungen Nachwuchstalente Judith Koch und Aaron Hitz nebst gestandenen Schweizer Stars wie Beat Schlatter und Dorothee Muggler verpflichten. In Nebenrollen tauchen auch Alexandra Prusa, Michael Neuenschwander und Max Rudlinger auf.

In beiden Gruppen stellen sich Fragen rund um Schuld, Verantwortung und Einverstandnis.Die Regisseurin Lea Bloch wurde 2023 am Filmfestival Locarno fur ihren Kurzfilm «Letzte Nacht» mit dem «Pardino doro» fur den besten Schweizer Kurzfilm und mit dem «Best Swiss Newcomer Award» gleich doppelt geehrt.

programme.title: Discipline / Discipline
programme.desc: It is shortly before the shop closes. There is a crowd in a mixed goods in Lausanne. A annoyed father misses his unreasonable daughter. When a shocked customer interferes and a glass falls to the ground, a dispute is inflated across the language boundaries that spreads like a running fire in the whole shop. "Discipline" creates a real suction with his perfectly timed punch lines and shows in a humorous way how Dunn is the ice between order and chaos. Egypters born in Cairo. After training in Egypt and in the USA, he began studying film on the Écal (École Cantonale Dart de Lausanne) in 2010 and successfully completed his bachelor with “Discipline” in 2014. His short film has been doing a remarkable career for over a year. programme.desc: "One, two, three, four, five, six ..." pays a man with a serious mine. A woman and another man pay with - her eyes look into the void. But you forgot how to proceed. programme.desc: "I can't believe that I have allowed it," says Hutch Mansell after a ganovenpart has caught his family's house. " Large explosions. Epic fist fights. Bob Odenkirk had to do combat training for two years to play the scenes themselves, ”said“ The Bund ”was impressed. / «Ich kann nicht glauben, dass ich das zugelassen habe», hinterfragt sich Hutch Mansell , nachdem ein Ganovenparchen das Haus seiner Familie uberfallen hat. Der Familienvater hatte zwar einen Golfschlager zur Hand, liess die Einbrecher jedoch ziehen - die spottischen Blicke der herbeigerufenen Blicke sind ihm ebenso sicher wie die Enttauschung von Frau und Sohn.Doch der vom Alltag zermurbte Revisor lasst die Sache nicht auf sich sitzen. Grosse Explosionen. Epische Faustkampfe. Bob Odenkirk musste zwei Jahre lang Kampftraining absolvieren, um die Szenen selbst spielen zu konnen», zeigte sich «Der Bund» beeindruckt.

programme.desc: The Bern flag is hoisted, and the red clove bust is in the bodice. Verena Chervet awaits the country women on her farm in Clavaleyres. programme.desc: Whether on the tractor, the round bale machine or the Mini Trax: Tanja Bisacca probably feels with large machines. And otherwise she is "her husband". Because she almost sincerely grief around the nine Pinzgau suckler cows and around the 700 Merlot vine around her house in the Bleniotal. programme.title: FIFA Club World Cup 2025 / FIFA Club World Cup 2025
programme.desc: Live the matches of the first edition of the Maximum International Soccer Club Tournament organized by FIFA, which will be played by 32 teams of the six continental confederations. It has been played from June 15 to July 13, 2025 in 12 different stages, being the metlife stadium that houses the final. Chelsea faces Paris Saint-Germain in the FIFA 2025 Club World Cup final. An exciting duel that promises to be a great football show. / Vive los partidos de la primera edicion del máximo torneo internacional de clubes de fútbol organizado por la FIFA, que será disputado por 32 equipos de las seis confederaciones continentales. Se disputa desde el 15 de junio hasta el 13 de julio de 2025 en 12 estadios distintos, siendo el MetLife Stadium el que albergue la final. Chelsea se enfrenta a Paris Saint-Germain en la final de la Copa Mundial de Clubes de la FIFA 2025. Un duelo emocionante que promete ser un gran espectáculo futbolístico.
